attributes.description: Indicates whether customer membership in this segment is automatically recalculated on a scheduled basis (True) or manually managed (False). True for dynamic segments (e.g., RFM tiers recalculated nightly); False for static segments (e.g., one-time campaign lists).

attributes.name: average_aov
attributes.description: Mean Average Order Value for customers in this segment over the measurement period. Key metric for pricing strategy, promotion design, and basket optimization. Expressed in base currency (USD).

attributes.name: average_cltv
attributes.description: Mean Customer Lifetime Value across all customers currently assigned to this segment. Used for segment valuation, investment prioritization, and ROI forecasting. Expressed in base currency (USD).

attributes.name: average_purchase_frequency
attributes.description: Mean number of transactions per customer in this segment over the measurement period (typically 12 months). Used for replenishment forecasting, loyalty program design, and churn prediction.

attributes.name: avg_basket_size
attributes.description: Average basket size for the segment in the customer domain (avg basket size).

attributes.name: b2b_b2c_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment applies to B2B customers (business accounts, wholesale, corporate), B2C customers (individual consumers), or both. Drives differentiated engagement strategies, pricing models, and service levels.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_honored_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Honored Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment respects CCPA 'Do Not Sell My Personal Information' opt-out requests (True) or is exempt (False, e.g., service-related communications). Ensures compliance for California residents.

tag_set.value: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Honored Flag

attributes.name: churn_risk_score
attributes.description: Aggregate churn risk score for this segment, ranging from 0.00 (no risk) to 100.00 (high risk). Calculated from recency, frequency, and engagement metrics. Drives retention campaign prioritization and at-risk customer interventions.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the segment for operational use (e.g., VIP_GOLD, LAPSED_90D, HIGH_VALUE_B2B). Used in marketing campaigns, pricing rules, and POS systems.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment definition was first created in the system. Audit trail for segment lifecycle tracking and governance.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the segment's defining characteristics, business rationale, and strategic purpose. Includes target customer profile, expected behaviors, and recommended engagement strategies.

attributes.name: discount_sensitivity
attributes.description: Behavioral classification of segment's responsiveness to promotional pricing. High: primarily purchases on promotion (Hi-Lo shoppers). Medium: balanced full-price and promotional purchases. Low: primarily full-price purchases (EDLP preference or premium segment).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment definition was retired or superseded. Null for currently active segments. Enables segment lifecycle management and historical reporting.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment definition became active and available for customer assignment. Supports temporal segmentation strategies and historical analysis.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit customer consent is required under GDPR for marketing communications to this segment (True) or whether legitimate interest or other legal basis applies (False). Ensures regulatory compliance for EU customers.

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Required Flag

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic boundary or region to which this segment applies (e.g., 'USA', 'Northeast Region', 'Urban Markets', 'Global'). Supports localized segmentation strategies and regional campaign targeting. Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where applicable.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment definition was last updated (criteria, name, status, or any other attribute). Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when segment membership was last recalculated and customer assignments were updated. Critical for data freshness validation and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: max_rfm_score
attributes.description: Maximum RFM composite score for customer assignment to this segment (if segment_type is rfm_tier). Defines the upper bound of the RFM tier. Null for non-RFM segments.

attributes.name: membership_count
attributes.description: Current count of customers assigned to this segment. Updated periodically based on auto-refresh schedule. Used for segment sizing, campaign planning, and capacity forecasting.

attributes.name: min_rfm_score
attributes.description: Minimum RFM composite score required for customer assignment to this segment (if segment_type is rfm_tier). RFM scores typically range from 3 (lowest: 1-1-1) to 15 (highest: 5-5-5). Null for non-RFM segments.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the segment (e.g., 'VIP Gold Tier', 'Lapsed Customers - 90 Days', 'High-Value B2B Accounts'). Used in reporting, dashboards, and customer-facing communications.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Average Net Promoter Score for customers in this segment, ranging from -100.00 (all detractors) to +100.00 (all promoters). Measures customer satisfaction, loyalty, and likelihood to recommend. Used for segment health monitoring and experience improvement prioritization.

attributes.name: owning_business_unit
attributes.description: Name of the business unit or department responsible for defining, maintaining, and governing this segment (e.g., 'Marketing Analytics', 'Customer Insights', 'Loyalty Program Management'). Establishes accountability for segment quality and usage.

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Service and engagement priority level assigned to this segment. Platinum: highest CLTV, white-glove service. Gold: high-value, priority support. Silver: mid-value, standard service. Bronze: emerging value. Standard: baseline service. Drives clienteling strategies and resource allocation.

attributes.name: qualification_criteria
attributes.description: Summary of the business rules and thresholds used to assign customers to this segment (e.g., 'Purchased in last 30 days AND total spend > $5000 in last 12 months', 'RFM Score >= 9', 'Age 25-34 AND lives in urban area'). Human-readable representation of the segmentation logic.

attributes.name: refresh_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which segment membership is recalculated for auto-refresh segments. Daily: high-velocity behavioral segments. Weekly: standard RFM tiers. Monthly: demographic or lifecycle segments. Quarterly: strategic value tiers. On-Demand: manual trigger only.

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment definition. Active: in production use for customer assignment and campaigns. Inactive: temporarily suspended, no new assignments. Archived: retired, historical reference only. Draft: under development, not yet released.

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segmentation methodology applied. RFM Tier: Recency, Frequency, Monetary analysis. Demographic: age, gender, income. Behavioral: purchase patterns, product affinity. Psychographic: lifestyle, values. Lifecycle Stage: new, active, at-risk, lapsed. Geographic: region, climate zone. Channel Preference: omnichannel, e-commerce-only, store-only. Value Tier: CLTV-based stratification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rfm_tier|demographic|behavioral|psychographic|lifecycle_stage|geographic|channel_preference|value_tier — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_marketing_channel
attributes.description: Primary communication channel recommended for engaging customers in this segment. Aligns segment strategy with channel preference and regulatory consent. All Channels: omnichannel engagement strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|sms|push_notification|direct_mail|in_store|call_center|social_media|all_channels — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: interaction
products.description: Records every customer touchpoint, engagement event, and outbound communication across all Retail channels sourced from SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) and the case management system. Stores interaction type (POS visit, website session, app open, call center contact, email send/open/click, SMS send/delivery, push notification, chat, clienteling visit, NPS survey response), direction (inbound/outbound), channel, store or digital property, timestamp, duration, outcome, NPS score (when applicable), associated campaign or promotion ID, delivery status and engagement metrics for outbound messages (delivered/opened/clicked/bounced/unsubscribed), and agent/associate ID. This is the single consolidated product for all customer communication and engagement history — foundation for omnichannel interaction timeline, communication audit trail, campaign response tracking, and CLTV modeling. Deployed to retail_mvm (MVM) and retail_mvm (ECM) as distinct schemas.

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer interaction event. Primary key.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: In-store customer service tracking and department-level NPS/sentiment reporting requires knowing which department an interaction occurred in. Retail operations teams report on service quality and comp

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical store location where the interaction occurred. Applicable for in-store interactions (POS visit, clienteling visit, in-store event). Null for digital interactions.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who participated in this interaction. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Campaign response tracking — email opens, clicks, and digital interactions are attributed to specific promotional campaigns in retail. This FK enables campaign engagement reporting, A/B test analysis,

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to returns.rma. Business justification: Customer service operations log interactions (calls, chats, emails) against specific RMAs — a named retail customer service process. Enables RMA-level interaction history reporting, SLA tracking, and

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Product Interaction Tracking: retail customer service and digital analytics require linking interaction events (product views, support calls, complaints, returns inquiries) to the specific SKU involve

attributes.name: browser
attributes.description: The web browser used by the customer during this interaction (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). Applicable for web-based interactions. Null for non-web interactions.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel or medium through which the interaction occurred (e.g., store, web, mobile app, call center, email, SMS, push notification, social media, kiosk). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: store|web|mobile_app|call_center|email|sms|push|social_media|kiosk|chat|video — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this interaction record was first created in the data platform. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: The delivery and engagement status for outbound communication interactions (email, SMS, push notification). Indicates whether the message was delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, or failed. Null for inbound or non-message interactions.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the customer during this interaction (e.g., desktop, mobile, tablet, kiosk, POS terminal). Applicable for digital and in-store interactions. Null if device type is unknown.

attributes.name: digital_property
attributes.description: The specific digital asset or platform where the interaction occurred (e.g., main website, mobile app, partner site, social media platform name). Applicable for digital interactions. Null for in-store interactions.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interaction was initiated by the customer (inbound) or by Retail (outbound).

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: The length of the interaction in seconds. Applicable for sessions, calls, chats, and visits. Null for instantaneous events (e.g., email send, SMS send).

attributes.name: email_clicked_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer clicked a link within an outbound email. Applicable only for email interactions. Null for non-email interactions.

attributes.name: email_opened_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether an outbound email was opened by the customer. Applicable only for email interactions. Null for non-email interactions.

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude
attributes.description: The latitude coordinate of the customer location at the time of this interaction, if available. Applicable for mobile app interactions with location services enabled. Null if location data is unavailable.

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude
attributes.description: The longitude coordinate of the customer location at the time of this interaction, if available. Applicable for mobile app interactions with location services enabled. Null if location data is unavailable.

attributes.name: interaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the interaction event occurred. This is the business event timestamp (when the customer engaged), distinct from record audit timestamps.

attributes.name: interaction_type
attributes.description: The category of customer touchpoint or engagement event. Defines the nature of the interaction (e.g., POS visit, website session, app open, call center contact, email send, SMS send, push notification, chat, clienteling visit, NPS survey response). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pos_visit|website_session|mobile_app_open|call_center_contact|email_campaign|sms_campaign|push_notification|live_chat|clienteling_visit|nps_survey|social_media_engagement|kiosk_interaction|video_call|in_store_event — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the customer device during this interaction. Applicable for digital interactions. Null for in-store interactions. May be considered PII in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: landing_page_url
attributes.description: The URL of the first page visited by the customer during this interaction session. Applicable for web-based interactions. Null for non-web interactions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the associate or agent during or after the interaction. Captures additional context, customer requests, or follow-up actions. Null if no notes were recorded.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The Net Promoter Score (NPS) provided by the customer during or after this interaction, if applicable. Scale 0-10. Null if no NPS was collected.

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: The operating system of the device used during this interaction (e.g., Windows, macOS, iOS, Android). Applicable for digital interactions. Null for non-digital interactions.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The result or resolution status of the interaction (e.g., completed, abandoned, escalated, resolved, converted, bounced, unsubscribed). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: completed|abandoned|escalated|resolved|converted|bounced|unsubscribed|pending|transferred|no_response — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: referrer_url
attributes.description: The URL of the page or source that referred the customer to this interaction (e.g., search engine, social media, email link). Applicable for web-based interactions. Null for non-web interactions.

attributes.name: sentiment_score
attributes.description: A numeric score representing the sentiment or emotional tone of the interaction, derived from text analytics or voice analytics. Scale typically -1.0 (negative) to +1.0 (positive). Null if sentiment analysis was not performed.

attributes.name: sms_delivered_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether an outbound SMS message was successfully delivered to the customer. Applicable only for SMS interactions. Null for non-SMS interactions.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: A brief subject or title describing the purpose or topic of the interaction (e.g., product inquiry, order status check, complaint, feedback). Applicable for call center contacts, service cases, and clienteling visits. Null for automated or non-subject-based interactions.

attributes.name: unsubscribed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer unsubscribed from communications as a result of this interaction. Applicable for outbound communication interactions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this interaction record was last updated in the data platform. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

products.name: payment_method
products.description: DEPRECATED: Payment method records for customers. This table is superseded by finance.payment_instrument for PCI DSS isolation. Retained as a view/reference for backward compatibility; new integrations should use finance.payment_instrument.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Primary key for payment_method

attributes.name: billing_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: payment_method has embedded billing address fields (billing_address_line1, billing_address_line2, billing_city, billing_state_province, billing_postal_code, billing_country_code) that should be normal

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who owns this payment method. Links to the customer master record for omnichannel recognition and clienteling.

attributes.name: bin_number
attributes.description: First six digits of the card number (Bank Identification Number). Used for card type identification, fraud detection, and routing. Not considered sensitive under PCI DSS.

attributes.name: bnpl_provider
attributes.description: Buy-now-pay-later provider. Free-form string; common values include: klarna, affirm, afterpay, zip, sezzle.

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: Brand of the payment card; common values include visa, mastercard, amex, discover.

attributes.name: card_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the card was issued. Derived from BIN lookup. Used for fraud detection and international transaction processing.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Full name of the cardholder. PII-sensitive; masked in non-production environments. Canonical source now in finance.payment_instrument.

attributes.name: consent_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer provided consent to store this payment method (web, mobile app, POS, call center, in-store). Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer provided consent to store this payment method. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment method record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and customer lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: deactivated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment method was deactivated. Null if the payment method is still active. Used for lifecycle tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the payment method was deactivated. Used for customer service, fraud analysis, and operational reporting.

attributes.name: digital_wallet_provider
attributes.description: Digital wallet provider. Free-form string; common values include: apple_pay, google_pay, paypal, samsung_pay, venmo.

attributes.name: expiry_month
attributes.description: Expiration month of the payment card (1-12). Used to validate card validity at checkout and trigger proactive customer notifications for expiring cards.

attributes.name: expiry_year
attributes.description: Expiration year of the payment card (four-digit year). Used to validate card validity at checkout and trigger proactive customer notifications for expiring cards.

attributes.name: gift_card_balance
attributes.description: Current balance remaining on the gift card. Updated after each transaction. Applicable only when payment_method_type is gift_card.

attributes.name: gift_card_number
attributes.description: Tokenized or masked gift card number. Applicable only when payment_method_type is gift_card. Used for gift card balance inquiries and redemption.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this payment method is currently active and available for use. Inactive methods are retained for historical transaction reference but cannot be used for new purchases.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the customers default payment method for one-click checkout and recurring purchases. Only one payment method per customer should be marked as default.

attributes.name: issuing_bank
attributes.description: Name of the bank or financial institution that issued the payment card. Used for transaction routing and fraud detection.

attributes.name: last_four_digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the card number for customer recognition and display purposes. Used in clienteling and checkout confirmation screens.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Date when this payment method was last used for a transaction. Used for RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) analytics and customer engagement.

attributes.name: nickname
attributes.description: Customer-defined nickname for this payment method (e.g., My Visa, Work Card, Personal Checking). Used for customer convenience in payment selection.

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Type of payment method. Allowed values: credit_card, debit_card, wallet, gift_card, store_credit, bnpl.

attributes.name: payment_processor
attributes.description: Name of the payment processor or gateway used to process transactions with this payment method (e.g., Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, Cybersource). Used for transaction routing and reconciliation.

attributes.name: primary_digital_wallet_account_reference
attributes.description: Tokenized identifier for the digital wallet account. Used for digital wallet transactions and reconciliation.

attributes.name: processor_token
attributes.description: Payment processor-specific token for this payment method. Used for transaction processing and vault management.

attributes.name: store_credit_balance
attributes.description: Current balance of store credit available to the customer. Typically issued from returns or promotional campaigns. Applicable only when payment_method_type is store_credit.

attributes.name: token
attributes.description: PCI DSS compliant tokenized reference to the payment instrument. No raw PAN (Primary Account Number) is stored. Token is used for recurring purchases and one-click checkout.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment method record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this payment method has been used for transactions. Used for RFM analytics and customer behavior analysis.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment method was last verified. Used for compliance and fraud prevention tracking.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of payment method verification (e.g., AVS check, CVV verification, micro-deposit confirmation). Used for fraud prevention and risk management.

attributes.name: wallet_provider
attributes.description: Digital wallet provider; common values include apple_pay, google_pay, paypal.

products.name: membership
products.description: [References SSOT: loyalty.loyalty_membership] Customer-to-membership assignment linking table. References loyalty.loyalty_membership as the authoritative membership record. Tracks segment-based membership assignments and qualification methods.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Primary key for customer_membership

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the segment definition to which this profile is assigned

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Loyalty membership tiers directly determine price list eligibility in retail. price_list.loyalty_tier_code confirms this design intent. The POS and e-commerce pricing engine resolves the active member

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer profile participating in this segment membership

attributes.name: assignment_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0.00-100.00) indicating the strength of this customer's qualification for this segment. For rule-based assignments, reflects how strongly the customer meets qualification criteria. For ML-based assignments, reflects model prediction confidence. Used for prioritizing marketing outreach and identifying borderline members.

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which this customer was assigned to this segment. AutoRefresh: automatically assigned via scheduled segment refresh process. ManualOverride: manually assigned by business user overriding qualification rules. RuleEngine: assigned via real-time rule evaluation. MLModel: assigned via predictive model scoring. BulkImport: assigned via batch data load.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this membership record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: customer_membership_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this segment membership. Active: customer currently qualifies and membership is in effect. Expired: membership ended due to disqualification or time-based expiry. Suspended: temporarily inactive due to business rules. PendingQualification: awaiting next refresh cycle to confirm eligibility.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this customer profile exited this segment or the membership was terminated. Null for currently active memberships. Used for churn analysis and segment tenure calculations.

attributes.name: fee
attributes.description: The membership fee of the customer membership.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this membership record was last updated (status change, confidence score update, override modification). Audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: last_qualification_check_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent evaluation of this customer's eligibility for this segment. Updated during auto-refresh cycles or manual re-qualification checks. Used for audit trails and determining when next qualification check is due.

attributes.name: manual_override_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this membership was manually assigned by a business user, overriding automated qualification rules. True: manual override in effect, customer may not meet standard qualification criteria. False: standard rule-based or automated assignment. Used for governance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by business user when manual_override_flag is true. Documents business justification for overriding automated qualification rules (e.g., 'VIP customer per executive request', 'Strategic account exception', 'Retention offer'). Null when no override is in effect.

attributes.name: renewal_rate
attributes.description: The renewal rate of the customer membership.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when this customer profile was assigned to this segment and the membership became active. Used for lifecycle tracking and historical analysis of segment transitions.

attributes.name: oms_reference_code
attributes.description: External reference identifier from the Order Management System for end-to-end order orchestration and tracking.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the order was placed by the customer. Principal business event timestamp for the transaction.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the order. Used for customer communication, tracking, and cross-system reference.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the order in the fulfillment workflow. Tracks progression from creation through final disposition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|confirmed|processing|picking|packing|shipped|delivered|completed|cancelled|returned — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of order fulfillment method. BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store), SFS (Ship From Store), or standard home delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|bopis|ropis|ship_from_store|drop_ship|exchange|replacement — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument used for the order. Identifies the payment type without exposing sensitive card details. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|apple_pay|google_pay|gift_card|store_credit|cash|check|bank_transfer — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of payment processing for the order. Tracks authorization, capture, and settlement lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|authorized|captured|paid|failed|refunded|partially_refunded — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date committed to the customer for order delivery. Used for SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested target delivery date. Used for scheduling and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: shipping_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the shipping address including street number and name. Primary delivery location identifier.

attributes.name: shipping_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the shipping address for apartment, suite, or unit number. Optional address detail.

attributes.name: shipping_amount
attributes.description: Shipping and handling charges for order delivery. Zero for in-store pickup orders.

attributes.name: shipping_city
attributes.description: City or municipality for the shipping address.

attributes.name: shipping_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the shipping address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR).

attributes.name: shipping_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the shipping address. Critical for carrier routing and delivery zone determination.

attributes.name: shipping_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region for the shipping address. Used for tax jurisdiction and carrier routing.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Customer-provided delivery instructions or notes (e.g., gate code, leave at door, signature required).

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all line item amounts before taxes, discounts, and shipping charges. Base merchandise value.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax applied to the order based on jurisdiction and product taxability rules.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for shipment visibility and customer self-service tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this order header record was last modified. Audit trail for record changes.

products.name: order_line
products.description: [SSOT Owner] Authoritative source for order line items. Captures what the customer ordered including SKU, quantity, pricing, and tax details. The commercial record of the transaction.
products.reference: OMS Order Line / SAP SD Sales Order Item

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order line item. Primary key for the order line product.

attributes.name: digital_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.digital_catalog. Business justification: Ecommerce order attribution: retailers must trace which digital catalog listing (product page, content version, SEO entry) drove each order line purchase. Required for catalog content performance repo

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center, store, or warehouse assigned to fulfill this line. Supports split-fulfillment where different lines ship from different nodes.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent order header. Links this line item to its containing order transaction.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot. Business justification: Lot traceability is mandatory for recalls, quality issues, and regulatory compliance in retail (especially food, pharma, cosmetics). Fulfillment systems must record which specific lot/batch was picked

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotion applied to this line item. Links to the promotion master for discount calculation and campaign tracking.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Order lines must reference the product SKU being ordered. The product_description column becomes redundant as it can be joined from product.sku. This is a fundamental cross-domain relationship between

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: Order lines capture actual transaction prices. Linking to sku_price enables margin variance analysis, promotional effectiveness measurement, price compliance auditing, and reconciliation between plann

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: Order line fulfillment requires UOM conversion factor lookups for inventory deduction accuracy, carrier weight calculations, and cross-channel unit reconciliation. Current unit_of_measure string preve

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Direct Ship Vendor (DSV) fulfillment: in retail, drop-ship order lines are routed to a specific vendor for direct-to-consumer fulfillment. This FK enables EDI order transmission, vendor performance tr

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date when this line item was shipped from the fulfillment node. Used for SLA performance measurement and delivery estimation.

attributes.name: backorder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is on backorder due to insufficient inventory at order time. True if the item will be shipped when inventory becomes available.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why this line was cancelled. Populated only when line_status is CANCELLED. Enables root cause analysis of order cancellations.

attributes.name: cancelled_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity cancelled and not fulfilled. Tracks partial cancellations where only a portion of the ordered quantity is cancelled.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipping carrier assigned to deliver this line item. Supports multi-carrier fulfillment strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FEDEX|UPS|USPS|DHL|ONTRAC|LASERSHIP|LOCAL_COURIER — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: Unit cost of the product at the time of order fulfillment. Used for margin analysis and profitability reporting. Business-confidential financial data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was first created in the system. Represents the moment the line item was added to the order.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line. Supports multi-currency transactions in global retail operations.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to this line item. Includes promotional discounts, markdowns, coupons, and loyalty rewards applied at the line level.

attributes.name: expected_ship_date
attributes.description: Planned date when this line item is expected to ship from the fulfillment node. Used for customer communication and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: extended_price
attributes.description: Total price for this line item before discounts and taxes. Calculated as ordered_quantity multiplied by unit_retail_price.

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: Method by which this line will be fulfilled. Supports omnichannel fulfillment including ship-to-home, Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS), Ship-from-Store (SFS), and drop-ship.

attributes.name: gift_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is marked as a gift. True if the customer designated this item for gift wrapping, gift messaging, or special handling.

attributes.name: gift_message
attributes.description: Customer-provided gift message to be included with this line item. Populated only when gift_flag is true.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: 14-digit Global Trade Item Number. International standard for product identification across the supply chain.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the order. Determines the display and processing order of line items within a single order header.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of this order line. Tracks the line through the fulfillment lifecycle from order confirmation to final delivery or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PENDING|CONFIRMED|ALLOCATED|PICKED|PACKED|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|CANCELLED|RETURNED — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: margin_amount
attributes.description: Gross margin for this line item calculated as line_total minus cost_of_goods_sold. Key metric for profitability analysis and Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) calculations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was last modified. Tracks any updates to quantity, status, pricing, or fulfillment details.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the product ordered by the customer. Supports fractional quantities for weight-based or volume-based items.

attributes.name: original_sku
attributes.description: Original SKU that was ordered by the customer, populated only when substitution_flag is true. Enables tracking of substitution patterns and customer acceptance rates.

attributes.name: personalization_notes
attributes.description: Special instructions for product personalization such as monogramming, engraving, or custom text. Captured at order time and passed to fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why this line was returned by the customer. Populated when returned_quantity is greater than zero. Supports Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) processing.

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity returned by the customer after delivery. Supports partial returns and links to Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) processing.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity shipped to the customer. May differ from ordered_quantity due to partial fulfillment, substitutions, or inventory constraints.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit code identifying the specific product variant at the most granular level. Used for inventory tracking and fulfillment.

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a substitution for an out-of-stock product. True if a substitute product was provided instead of the originally ordered item.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charged on this line item. Includes sales tax, VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction and product category.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction for this line item. Determines applicable tax rates based on ship-to location and product tax category.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Effective tax rate applied to this line item expressed as a decimal. For example, 0.0825 represents 8.25 percent sales tax.

attributes.name: total
attributes.description: Final total amount for this line item after discounts and taxes. Calculated as extended_price minus discount_amount plus tax_amount.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier tracking number for this line item shipment. Enables customer self-service tracking and last-mile delivery visibility.

attributes.name: unit_retail_price
attributes.description: Price per unit at the time of order. Represents the Average Unit Retail (AUR) before any line-level discounts or promotions.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code barcode identifier. Standard North American product identifier used at point of sale.

products.name: pos_transaction
products.description: Point-of-Sale transaction record for in-store purchase events at registers. Captures POS terminal ID, register number, cashier/associate ID, store number, transaction date/time, transaction type (sale, return, exchange, void), total tender, tax, discount, loyalty card number, basket metrics (item count, UPT, ATV), and fiscal receipt number. SSOT for brick-and-mortar register transactions. Complements order_header for transactions originating at physical registers rather than digital order flow. Payment tenders linked via the payment product.
products.reference: SAP CAR POS Transaction / NRF ARTS Transaction

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the POS transaction record. Primary key for in-store register transactions.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: B2B in-store purchases on account (net-30 terms, employee discount accounts, corporate charge accounts) require linking POS transactions to customer accounts. pos_transaction links to profile but not

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order header for omnichannel transactions such as BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) pickups or ship-from-store fulfillments that originated as digital orders.

attributes.name: original_transaction_pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original POS transaction being returned or exchanged when transaction_type is return or exchange.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the POS terminal device used to process the transaction.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: POS transactions execute under a specific price list (regular, employee, clearance). Stamping the active price list on the transaction enables price list performance reporting, in-store pricing audit,

attributes.name: primary_pos_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store location where the transaction occurred.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who made the purchase. Populated when loyalty card is scanned or customer account is identified.

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: Retail business day to which this transaction is attributed for financial reporting. May differ from transaction timestamp for transactions after store closing but before end-of-day processing.

attributes.name: change_amount
attributes.description: Cash change returned to the customer when tender_amount exceeds total_amount.

attributes.name: coupon_count
attributes.description: Number of coupons redeemed in the transaction including manufacturer coupons and store coupons.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the POS transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction monetary amounts.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the transaction including promotional discounts, coupons, markdowns, and employee discounts.

attributes.name: fiscal_receipt_number
attributes.description: Government-mandated fiscal receipt identifier for tax compliance and audit purposes. Required in jurisdictions with fiscal receipt regulations.

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Fulfillment method for the transaction distinguishing between traditional in-store purchases and omnichannel fulfillment scenarios.

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items in the transaction basket. Used for basket analysis and UPT (Units Per Transaction) calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the POS transaction record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data synchronization.

attributes.name: loyalty_card_number
attributes.description: Loyalty program card number scanned during the transaction for points accrual and customer identification.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the customer for this transaction based on purchase amount and promotional multipliers.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the customer during this transaction for discounts or rewards.

attributes.name: manager_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a manager override was required during the transaction for actions such as large discounts, voids, or policy exceptions.

attributes.name: payment_method_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct payment methods used in the transaction. Supports split-tender analysis.

attributes.name: primary_payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument used for the transaction. For split-tender transactions, this is the method with the largest payment amount. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|credit_card|debit_card|gift_card|mobile_payment|check|store_credit — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: promotion_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct promotions applied to the transaction. Used for promotional effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: receipt_email
attributes.description: Email address provided by the customer for digital receipt delivery.

attributes.name: receipt_phone
attributes.description: Phone number provided by the customer for SMS receipt delivery or order pickup notifications.

attributes.name: register_number
attributes.description: Physical register or checkout lane number within the store where the transaction was processed.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for return when transaction_type is return. Used for return analytics and product quality monitoring.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all line item amounts before taxes, fees, and discounts are applied.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax charged on the transaction based on applicable tax jurisdiction and product tax categories.

attributes.name: tender_amount
attributes.description: Total amount tendered by the customer across all payment methods. May exceed total_amount when cash change is given.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount tendered by the customer including all items, taxes, fees, and after all discounts. Represents the net transaction value and ATV (Average Transaction Value).

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of all items purchased in the transaction, summed across all line items. May differ from item_count when multiple units of the same SKU are purchased.

attributes.name: training_mode_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction was processed in training mode for new cashier onboarding. Training transactions are excluded from financial reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-readable transaction number printed on the customer receipt. Externally visible identifier for customer service and returns processing.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the POS transaction indicating whether it was completed, voided, suspended for later completion, or refunded.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was completed at the register. Primary business event timestamp for sales analytics and footfall analysis.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of POS transaction distinguishing between sales, returns, exchanges, voids, and no-sale register opens.

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for voiding the transaction when transaction_status is voided. Used for fraud detection and operational quality monitoring.

products.name: pos_transaction_line
products.description: Individual line-item detail within a POS transaction. Captures SKU, UPC, EAN, GTIN, item description, quantity sold, unit retail price, extended price, markdown amount, promotion code applied, tax code, tax amount, return reason (if applicable), serial number (for electronics), and weight (for variable-weight items). Supports basket analysis and sell-through rate calculations.
products.reference: SAP CAR POS Line Item / NRF ARTS LineItem

attributes.name: pos_transaction_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Transaction Line ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual line item within a POS transaction. Primary key for the transaction line detail record.

tag_set.value: Point of Sale (POS) Transaction Line ID

attributes.name: coupon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.coupon. Business justification: pos_transaction_line.coupon_code is a denormalized coupon reference. A proper FK to promotion.coupon enables coupon redemption reconciliation, single-use coupon enforcement, and vendor-funded coupon c

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: Department-level POS sales reporting, shrinkage tracking, and licensed-department regulatory compliance all require knowing which store department each transaction line belongs to. A retail domain exp

attributes.name: markdown_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.markdown. Business justification: POS line items sold at marked-down prices must reference the markdown event for sell-through reporting (units sold per markdown event) — a core retail KPI. The existing sku_price_id path does not dire

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent POS transaction header. Links this line item to the overall transaction.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: In-store POS line-item promotional reporting requires linking each sold line to the specific promo offer applied. Enables offer-level redemption analytics, vendor chargeback calculations, and promotio

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the master product record. Links to product information management system for detailed product attributes.

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: POS lines record actual selling prices at point of sale. Linking to sku_price enables real-time price verification, override detection, shrinkage analysis from pricing discrepancies, and margin tracki

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: Retail POS sells items by weight (lb/kg), volume, or each — requiring UOM master reference for variable-measure items, scale-integrated POS, and cross-channel UOM-consistent sales reporting. order_lin

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_item. Business justification: DSD (Direct Store Delivery) cost reconciliation and chargeback processing: POS transaction lines for DSD items must reference the specific vendor item record to validate unit cost, pack configuration,

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Product category or subcategory code within the department. Supports assortment planning and basket analysis.

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: Unit cost of the product at the time of sale. Used for gross margin calculation and profitability analysis. Business confidential.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction line record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trails.

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: 13-digit European Article Number for international product identification. Used for global product tracking and cross-border commerce.

attributes.name: extended_price
attributes.description: Total price for this line item calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price before discounts. Gross line amount before markdown.

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Method by which this line item was fulfilled. Supports omnichannel order orchestration and fulfillment analytics.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number that uniquely identifies trade items worldwide. Can be 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits depending on product type.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the product as it appears on the receipt. Includes brand, product name, size, and variant details.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the transaction. Determines the order in which items were scanned or entered at the point of sale.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned for this line item purchase. Used for customer loyalty program management and engagement.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed to discount this line item. Reduces the net amount paid by the customer.

attributes.name: markdown_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to this line item. Includes promotional discounts, coupons, and price reductions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction line record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: net_line_amount
attributes.description: Net amount for this line item after markdown but before tax. Calculated as extended price minus markdown amount.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is a store brand or private label item. True for private label, false for national brands.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Promotional campaign code applied to this line item. Links to promotion management system for campaign tracking and analysis.

attributes.name: quantity_sold
attributes.description: Number of units sold for this line item. Supports fractional quantities for variable-weight items such as produce and deli products.

attributes.name: return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item represents a product return. True for returned items, false for normal sales.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for product return. Used for return analytics and quality management.

attributes.name: scanned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this item was scanned or entered at the point of sale. Used for transaction timing analysis and basket sequence.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized products such as electronics and appliances. Used for warranty tracking and theft prevention.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit identifier for the product sold. Used for inventory tracking and assortment management.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax charged for this line item. Calculated by applying the tax rate to the net line amount.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction and category code for this line item. Determines applicable sales tax rate based on product category and location.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Sales tax rate applied to this line item expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.0825 represents 8.25 percent sales tax.

attributes.name: total_line_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount for this line item including tax. Sum of net line amount and tax amount.

attributes.name: unit_retail_price
attributes.description: Regular retail price per unit before any discounts or promotions. Represents the shelf price or list price of the item.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code scanned at point of sale. Standard barcode identifier for North American retail products.

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for voiding this line item. Used for shrinkage analysis and operational improvement.

attributes.name: voided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was voided or cancelled during the transaction. True for voided items, false for completed sales.

attributes.name: weight_actual
attributes.description: Actual weight of variable-weight items measured at point of sale. Captured for produce, deli, meat, and bakery items sold by weight.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the actual weight. Indicates whether weight is measured in pounds, kilograms, ounces, or grams.

products.name: payment
products.description: Payment tender record capturing each payment instrument applied to an order or POS transaction. Stores payment method type (credit card, debit, gift card, loyalty points, BNPL, cash, digital wallet), masked PAN/token, payment processor reference, authorization code, settlement status (authorized, captured, settled, declined, voided), payment amount, currency, tender sequence for split-tender scenarios, PCI DSS tokenization reference, fraud score, and 3DS authentication result. Supports split-tender where multiple payment methods cover a single order total. Integrates with PCI SSC compliance requirements and payment gateway APIs.
products.reference: OMS Payment / PCI DSS Payment Record

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment tender record. Primary key.

attributes.name: gift_card_id
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized gift card number used for this payment tender. Applicable only when payment method type is gift card.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order or POS (Point of Sale) transaction to which this payment tender is applied. Links payment to the originating order header.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.payment_method. Business justification: Payment reconciliation, chargeback management, and tokenized card lifecycle tracking require linking captured order payments to the customer's stored payment method. Enables 'all orders charged to thi

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction. Business justification: A payment tender record in a retail POS environment is directly associated with a specific POS transaction. While payment.header_id links to the order header, POS transactions are the immediate transa

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.shipment. Business justification: Ship-and-capture payment model: retail payments are authorized at order placement and captured on shipment. Linking payment to shipment enables automated capture triggers, financial reconciliation of

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount applied by this payment tender toward the order total. In split-tender scenarios, multiple payment records sum to the order total.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code returned by the payment processor or issuing bank confirming approval of the payment transaction. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was authorized by the payment processor or issuing bank. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this payment tender.

attributes.name: avs_result_code
attributes.description: Result code returned by Address Verification Service (AVS) indicating match status of billing address and postal code. Used for fraud prevention and risk assessment.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address associated with the payment method. Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address (apartment, suite, unit number). Optional field for AVS (Address Verification Service).

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the billing address associated with the payment method. Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the billing address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and international payment processing.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the billing address. Critical for AVS (Address Verification Service) validation and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the billing address. Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and tax calculation.

attributes.name: bnpl_provider
attributes.description: Free text; common values include klarna, affirm, afterpay, sezzle, etc.

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the authorized payment was captured (funds marked for settlement). Typically occurs at order fulfillment or shipment.

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: Free text; common values include visa, mastercard, amex, discover, jcb, unionpay, maestro, diners, rupay, regional/store cards

attributes.name: card_expiry_month
attributes.description: Expiration month of the payment card (1-12). Used for validation and recurring payment processing. Stored securely per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: card_expiry_year
attributes.description: Expiration year of the payment card (four-digit format, e.g., 2025). Used for validation and recurring payment processing. Stored securely per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the cardholder as it appears on the payment card. Used for verification and fraud prevention. Stored securely per PCI DSS and GDPR requirements.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the payment was initiated. Distinguishes web, mobile app, in-store POS (Point of Sale), call center, kiosk, or third-party platform.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment tender record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
