attributes.description: Phone number of the gift card recipient. Used for SMS delivery of digital cards and balance inquiries.

attributes.name: redemption_count
attributes.description: Total number of redemption transactions (purchases) made using this gift card since activation.

attributes.name: reload_count
attributes.description: Total number of times the gift card has been reloaded with additional funds since issuance. Zero for non-reloadable or never-reloaded cards.

attributes.name: reloadable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gift card can be reloaded with additional funds after initial issuance. True: reloadable; False: single-load only.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the terms and conditions that govern this gift card (e.g., expiration policy, fee schedule, usage restrictions). Used for compliance and customer service.

attributes.name: total_fees_charged
attributes.description: Cumulative fees deducted from the gift card balance (e.g., dormancy fees, maintenance fees, replacement fees). Subject to regulatory restrictions (e.g., CARD Act limits dormancy fees).

attributes.name: total_redeemed_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value redeemed from the gift card across all transactions since activation. Equals initial_balance + total_reloaded_amount - current_balance - total_fees.

attributes.name: total_reloaded_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value added to the gift card through all reload transactions since issuance. Excludes initial balance.

products.name: gift_card_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of gift card activations, loads, redemptions, balance inquiries, and escheatment events. Captures transaction type, amount, resulting balance, associated order/POS transaction, and channel.

attributes.name: gift_card_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the gift card transaction record.

attributes.name: gift_card_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the gift card involved in this transaction. May be masked for security.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the online order if this gift card activity was part of an e-commerce transaction.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical store where the transaction occurred. Null for online channels.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.payment. Business justification: When a gift card is redeemed as a payment instrument, both a payment record (capturing the tender) and a gift_card_transaction record (capturing the balance change) are created. These two records repr

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the POS terminal or kiosk where the transaction was processed.

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the POS transaction if this gift card activity was part of a store purchase or return.

attributes.name: primary_gift_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who performed the transaction. May be null for anonymous gift card purchases.

attributes.name: primary_original_transaction_gift_card_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original gift card transaction that is being reversed or refunded.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Channel-level gift card liability and fraud monitoring: gift card activations, redemptions, and reloads on ecommerce storefronts must be attributed to the specific storefront for per-channel liability

attributes.name: activation_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to the customer for activating or loading the gift card, if applicable.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization or approval code returned by the gift card processor for this transaction.

attributes.name: balance_after
attributes.description: Gift card balance immediately after this transaction was applied.

attributes.name: balance_before
attributes.description: Gift card balance immediately before this transaction was applied.

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: Fiscal business date on which the transaction is recorded for accounting and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the gift card transaction was initiated (POS, e-commerce, mobile app, call center, kiosk, third-party partner).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gift card transaction record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: escheatment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction represents an escheatment event where unclaimed gift card funds are transferred to state authorities.

attributes.name: escheatment_jurisdiction
attributes.description: State or jurisdiction to which unclaimed gift card funds were escheated, if applicable.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the gift card balance expires, if applicable. Null for non-expiring cards.

attributes.name: fraud_decision
attributes.description: Fraud system decision for this transaction (approved, declined, manual review required, customer challenge required).

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Risk score assigned by fraud detection system indicating likelihood of fraudulent activity (0-100 scale).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gift card transaction record was last updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the gift card transaction, typically entered by customer service or store associates.

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Type of payment method used to fund the gift card load or activation (credit card, debit card, cash, bank transfer, digital wallet, loyalty points).

attributes.name: processor_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the third-party gift card processor or payment gateway.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is a reversal or void of a previous gift card transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing or voiding the gift card transaction (e.g., customer request, fraud, system error).

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier in the source operational system for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the transaction. Positive for loads and activations, negative for redemptions.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction reference number for this gift card activity.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the gift card transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the gift card transaction occurred in the source system.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of gift card transaction: activation (initial issuance), load (add funds), redemption (spend funds), balance inquiry (check balance), escheatment (unclaimed property transfer), or reversal (void/refund).

products.name: subscription
products.description: Master record for recurring subscription orders (subscribe-and-save, auto-replenishment, meal kit subscriptions). Captures subscription ID, customer, SKU list, delivery frequency, next delivery date, payment method, and subscription status.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subscription record. Primary key for the subscription entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: B2B/corporate account subscription management requires linking subscriptions to customer accounts for credit limit enforcement, account status checks, and account-level subscription spend reporting. s

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier. Business justification: Recurring subscription deliveries require consistent carrier assignment for customer experience and SLA management. Business tracks preferred carrier at subscription level for cost optimization and de

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier_service. Business justification: Subscription service level (ground vs. expedited) drives recurring delivery promises and cost structure. Business needs carrier_service_id to enforce consistent service tier across subscription lifecy

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center, store, or fulfillment location assigned to process subscription orders. Links to the fulfillment node master record.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stored payment method used for recurring subscription charges. Links to the customer payment method record.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Subscriptions lock in pricing terms at enrollment. Linking to price_list enables subscription pricing governance, renewal price determination, grandfathered rate tracking, and price change impact anal

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who owns this subscription. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: subscription.promotion_code is a denormalized promo offer reference. Subscriptions are frequently acquired via promotional offers (e.g., 'first 3 months free'). A FK to promo_offer enables subscriptio

attributes.name: renewed_from_subscription_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on subscription (renewed_from_subscription_id)

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.replenishment_plan. Business justification: Subscription commerce (auto-replenishment programs for consumables, pet supplies, household goods) generates predictable demand patterns that drive dedicated replenishment plans. Retailers use this li

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the default delivery address for subscription orders. Links to the customer address record.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Subscribe-and-save / auto-replenishment subscriptions are tied to a specific SKU. Without sku_id on subscription, subscription revenue by product, SKU discontinuation impact on active subscriptions, a

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Subscriptions sold through digital channels require storefront attribution for revenue recognition, channel performance analysis, and fraud monitoring. Retail subscription businesses track which digit

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Base recurring charge amount for the subscription per billing cycle, excluding taxes, discounts, and shipping fees.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscription automatically renews at the end of its term. True for auto-renewing subscriptions, false for subscriptions that require manual renewal.

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which the customer is charged for the subscription: per_delivery for charges with each order, monthly for monthly billing regardless of delivery frequency, quarterly for every 3 months, annual for yearly billing, or upfront for prepaid subscriptions.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription was cancelled by the customer or system. Null for active subscriptions.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the subscription was cancelled (e.g., CUST_REQUEST, PAYMENT_FAILURE, PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE, FRAUD_DETECTED).

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of the subscription cancellation reason, providing additional context beyond the standardized code.

attributes.name: carrier_service_level
attributes.description: Shipping service tier for subscription deliveries: ground for economy shipping, express for expedited delivery, two_day for 2-day service, next_day for overnight, or standard for default carrier service.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the subscription was originally created: web for website, mobile_app for mobile application, call_center for phone orders, in_store for retail location sign-ups, chatbot for automated chat enrollment, or voice_assistant for smart speaker subscriptions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this subscription record was first created in the system, capturing the initial enrollment date and time.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this subscription record.

attributes.name: delivery_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which subscription orders are automatically generated and fulfilled: weekly for every 7 days, biweekly for every 14 days, monthly for every 30 days, quarterly for every 90 days, or custom for non-standard intervals.

attributes.name: delivery_frequency_days
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the delivery interval in days. Used for custom frequencies and precise scheduling calculations.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Recurring discount applied to each subscription billing cycle, such as promotional discounts, loyalty rewards, or volume-based savings.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription is scheduled to terminate. Null for open-ended subscriptions without a defined end date.

attributes.name: external_subscription_code
attributes.description: Subscription identifier from the source system or external platform, used for cross-system reconciliation and integration.

attributes.name: gift_message
attributes.description: Personalized message from the gift giver to the recipient, included with gift subscription deliveries.

attributes.name: gift_subscription_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subscription was purchased as a gift for another person. True for gift subscriptions, false for self-purchased subscriptions.

attributes.name: last_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent subscription order was delivered to the customer. Null if no deliveries have occurred yet.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this subscription record, tracking changes to subscription details, status, or preferences.

attributes.name: next_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date when the next subscription order is scheduled to be fulfilled and shipped to the customer.

attributes.name: pause_end_date
attributes.description: Date when a paused subscription is scheduled to resume. Null for indefinite pauses or active subscriptions.

attributes.name: pause_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription was paused. Null if the subscription has never been paused or is currently active.

attributes.name: skip_next_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has requested to skip the next scheduled delivery. True when the upcoming order should be skipped, false for normal delivery processing.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Customer-provided delivery instructions, preferences, or notes for subscription fulfillment (e.g., gate codes, preferred delivery times, substitution preferences).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription became active and the first delivery or service period began.

attributes.name: subscription_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the subscription, used in customer communications and service interactions.

attributes.name: subscription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the subscription: active for ongoing subscriptions, paused for temporarily suspended deliveries, cancelled for terminated subscriptions, expired for subscriptions past their end date, pending_activation for new subscriptions awaiting first order, or suspended for subscriptions on hold due to payment or compliance issues.

attributes.name: subscription_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subscription model: subscribe-and-save for recurring product delivery, auto-replenishment for inventory-triggered orders, meal kit for prepared meal subscriptions, curated box for personalized selections, membership for access-based subscriptions, or service plan for ongoing service contracts.

attributes.name: total_deliveries_completed
attributes.description: Cumulative count of subscription orders that have been successfully delivered to the customer since subscription inception.

attributes.name: total_deliveries_skipped
attributes.description: Cumulative count of scheduled deliveries that were skipped at the customer's request or due to system holds.

domains.name: store
domains.description: Manages physical retail locations including hypermarkets, department stores, discount outlets, dark stores, and micro-fulfillment centers (MFC). Owns store master records, planograms (POG), gondola and endcap configurations, footfall metrics, comp sales (SSS - Same-Store Sales), visual merchandising standards, POS terminal inventory, and store-level P&L. Supports store operations and omnichannel fulfillment as ship-from-store nodes.

products.name: location
products.description: Master record for every physical retail location operated by the business, including hypermarkets, department stores, discount outlets, dark stores, and micro-fulfillment centers (MFCs). Captures store number, banner/brand, format type (hypermarket, department, discount, dark store, MFC), format size band, assortment depth/breadth norms, staffing model type, fulfillment capability flags (BOPIS-capable, ROPIS-capable, SFS-capable, DSD-receiving), trading name, legal entity, opening date, closure date, remodel history, square footage (total and selling), number of floors, parking capacity, operating hours, time zone, locale, climate zone, accessibility certifications, and store lifecycle status. This is the SSOT for all store identity, classification, and format configuration data consumed by inventory, order, workforce, and finance domains.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical retail location. Primary key for the store_location data product. This is the system-of-record identifier used across all domains (inventory, order, workforce, finance) to reference this specific store, dark store, or micro-fulfillment center (MFC).

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_format. Business justification: Every store location is classified by a store format (hypermarket, discount outlet, department store, etc.). The store_location record currently denormalizes format_type as a STRING. Adding FK to stor

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Stores belong to price zones for regional pricing strategies. This is a fundamental retail concept - stores in the same geographic area or market segment share pricing rules. No visible redundant colu

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.region. Business justification: location currently stores region_code as a denormalized STRING. Adding region_id FK to store.region.region_id normalizes this relationship — a store location belongs to exactly one geographic region.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.sales_territory. Business justification: A store location belongs to exactly one sales territory for sales planning, rep assignment, and revenue targeting. The location table has district_code as a string but no FK to the sales_territory mas

attributes.name: accessibility_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store location is certified as fully accessible for customers with disabilities, meeting ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) or equivalent local accessibility standards. True = certified accessible; False = not certified or non-compliant.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the store location (street number and name). Used for customer navigation, delivery routing, and regulatory filings. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the store location (suite, unit, building). Null if not applicable. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: assortment_breadth_norm
attributes.description: Standard assortment breadth (range of categories) for this store format. Narrow = limited category count (convenience); Moderate = balanced category mix; Broad = wide category range; Very Broad = full-line assortment (hypermarket). Used for merchandising strategy.

attributes.name: assortment_depth_norm
attributes.description: Standard assortment depth (variety within a category) for this store format. Shallow = limited SKU count per category; Moderate = balanced SKU selection; Deep = extensive SKU variety; Very Deep = maximum SKU variety. Used for category management and space planning.

attributes.name: banner_brand
attributes.description: The retail banner or brand under which this location operates (e.g., 'Retail Hypermarket', 'Retail Discount', 'Retail Express'). Used for brand segmentation, assortment planning, and marketing strategy.

attributes.name: bopis_capable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store location supports BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) fulfillment. True = BOPIS enabled with dedicated pickup area; False = BOPIS not available. Used for omnichannel order routing and customer service.

tag_set.value: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Capable

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the store location is situated. Used for geographic segmentation, market analysis, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: climate_zone
attributes.description: Climate zone classification for the store location. Used for seasonal assortment planning, HVAC energy management, and merchandise mix optimization (e.g., winter apparel depth in continental zones).

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date this store location permanently ceased operations. Null for active stores. Used for historical analysis, lease termination tracking, and asset disposition planning.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the store location is situated (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Used for regulatory compliance, currency determination, and international reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this store location record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: district_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the retail district or region to which this store location belongs. Used for hierarchical reporting, district manager accountability, and regional performance analysis.

attributes.name: dsd_receiving
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store location accepts Direct Store Delivery (DSD) from vendors, bypassing the distribution center (DC). True = DSD receiving enabled; False = all inventory flows through DC. Common for beverages, snacks, and bread.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the store location. Used for operational communications, customer service escalations, and vendor coordination. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: format_size_band
attributes.description: Size classification band for the store format, used for assortment planning and operational benchmarking. Small = <20K sq ft; Medium = 20K-50K sq ft; Large = 50K-100K sq ft; Extra Large = >100K sq ft. Bands are format-specific.

attributes.name: last_remodel_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent major remodel or renovation of this store location. Used for capital expenditure tracking, store refresh planning, and performance analysis post-remodel.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the store location in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analysis, delivery routing, trade area mapping, and proximity-based customer targeting.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The legal entity name under which this store location operates. Used for regulatory filings, tax reporting, and legal compliance. May differ from the trading name.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the store location in its lifecycle. Planned = approved but not yet built; Under Construction = site work in progress; Open = actively trading; Temporarily Closed = closed for short-term reasons (weather, emergency); Permanently Closed = ceased operations; Remodeling = closed for renovation.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Locale identifier for the store location in format 'language_COUNTRY' (e.g., 'en_US', 'es_MX', 'fr_CA'). Used for localized pricing, signage, customer communications, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the store location in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analysis, delivery routing, trade area mapping, and proximity-based customer targeting.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the current store manager responsible for this location. Used for operational accountability, escalation routing, and organizational reporting. Business reference, not direct PII.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this store location record was last modified. Used for data lineage, change tracking, and audit trails. Updated on every record change.

attributes.name: number_of_floors
attributes.description: Total number of customer-accessible floors in the store location. Used for store layout planning, accessibility compliance, and customer flow analysis.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: The date this store location first opened for business. Used for comp sales (SSS - Same-Store Sales) calculations, anniversary planning, and store maturity analysis. Null for planned stores not yet opened.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the store location, typically in format 'Mon-Fri 8:00-22:00, Sat-Sun 9:00-21:00'. Used for workforce scheduling, customer communications, and omnichannel order fulfillment time windows.

attributes.name: parking_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of customer parking spaces available at the store location. Used for site selection, customer convenience analysis, and BOPIS/ROPIS pickup planning. Null for urban locations without dedicated parking.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the store location. Used for customer inquiries, BOPIS/ROPIS coordination, and operational communications. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the store location. Used for delivery routing, trade area analysis, and demographic segmentation. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: primary_dc_facility_code
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Every store has a primary DC assignment for standard replenishment routing. Fundamental retail supply chain topology required for: replenishment order routing, freight cost allocation, lead time calcu

attributes.name: ropis_capable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS) Capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store location supports ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store) fulfillment, where customers reserve items online and complete purchase in-store. True = ROPIS enabled; False = ROPIS not available.

tag_set.value: Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS) Capable

attributes.name: selling_square_footage
attributes.description: Square footage of customer-accessible selling floor space, excluding back-of-house, storage, and office areas. Used for sales per square foot calculations, planogram (POG) planning, and merchandising density analysis.

attributes.name: sfs_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store location is enabled as a Ship-from-Store (SFS) fulfillment node, capable of picking, packing, and shipping e-commerce orders directly from store inventory. True = SFS enabled; False = SFS not available.

attributes.name: staffing_model_type
attributes.description: The staffing model classification for this store format. Full Service = high staff-to-customer ratio with clienteling; Limited Service = moderate staffing; Self Service = minimal staff, customer self-checkout; Automated = dark store or MFC with no customer-facing staff.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province code (2-letter ISO or postal abbreviation) where the store location is situated. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, regulatory compliance, and regional reporting.

attributes.name: store_name
attributes.description: The trading name or display name of the store location as it appears to customers (e.g., 'Retail Superstore Downtown', 'Retail Express Market Hill'). Used for customer communications, receipts, and marketing materials.

attributes.name: store_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the store location. This is the human-readable store number used in operational communications, signage, and customer-facing materials. Unique within the retail banner/brand.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the store location (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'America/Chicago'). Used for POS transaction timestamping, workforce scheduling, and omnichannel order fulfillment coordination.

attributes.name: total_square_footage
attributes.description: Total building square footage of the store location, including selling floor, back-of-house, storage, and office space. Used for productivity metrics (sales per square foot), lease accounting, and facility management.

products.name: format
products.description: Reference classification of retail store formats used across the banner portfolio. Defines format codes and descriptions (hypermarket, superstore, department store, discount outlet, convenience, dark store, MFC, ship-from-store node), typical size bands (sq ft ranges), assortment depth/breadth norms, staffing model type, and fulfillment capability flags (BOPIS-capable, ROPIS-capable, SFS-capable, DSD-receiving). Used to drive operational standards, planogram templates, and omnichannel routing rules.

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the store format. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_format_id
attributes.description: Add column parent_format_id (BIGINT) to store.format with FK to store.format.format_id because store formats may have hierarchical relationships. P17: connect_table: store.format** - add column parent_format_id (BIGINT) with FK to store.for

attributes.name: assortment_breadth_level
attributes.description: Typical range of product categories carried by this format. Narrow = few categories (e.g., convenience); broad = many categories (e.g., hypermarket).

attributes.name: assortment_depth_level
attributes.description: Typical variety within each product category for this format. Shallow = limited SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) variety per category; deep = extensive SKU variety per category.

attributes.name: bopis_capable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) Capable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format are capable of supporting BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) fulfillment. True if BOPIS is supported; false otherwise.

tag_set.value: BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) Capable Flag

attributes.name: clienteling_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format offer clienteling (personalized in-store service) to customers. True if clienteling is offered; false otherwise.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the store format (e.g., HM for hypermarket, SS for superstore, DS for discount store, CONV for convenience, DARK for dark store, MFC for micro-fulfillment center).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this store format record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the store format including its purpose, target customer segment, and operational characteristics.

attributes.name: dsd_receiving_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format receive DSD (Direct Store Delivery) shipments directly from vendors, bypassing the DC (Distribution Center). True if DSD receiving is supported; false otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this store format definition was retired or deprecated. Null for currently active formats.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this store format definition became effective and available for use in store planning and operations.

attributes.name: endcap_count_typical
attributes.description: Typical number of endcaps (end-of-aisle displays) available for promotional merchandising in stores of this format.

attributes.name: format_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the store format. Active formats are in use across the banner portfolio; deprecated formats are being phased out; pilot formats are under testing.

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the format: physical_retail (customer-facing), fulfillment_only (dark store, MFC), or hybrid (ship-from-store capable retail location).

attributes.name: gondola_configuration_type
attributes.description: Typical gondola (shelving unit) configuration used in stores of this format. Defines the standard shelving layout and fixture type.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this store format record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format participate in the enterprise loyalty program. True if loyalty program is active; false otherwise.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the store format (e.g., Hypermarket, Superstore, Department Store, Discount Outlet, Convenience Store, Dark Store, Micro-Fulfillment Center, Ship-from-Store Node).

attributes.name: operating_hours_type
attributes.description: Typical operating hours pattern for stores of this format. 24_7 = open 24 hours; extended = long hours (e.g., 6am-midnight); standard = typical retail hours; limited = short hours; variable = hours vary by location.

attributes.name: parking_capacity_typical
attributes.description: Typical number of parking spaces available at stores of this format. Null for formats without customer parking (e.g., dark stores, MFCs).

attributes.name: planogram_template_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the standard planogram (POG - Shelf Layout Diagram) template used for visual merchandising in stores of this format. Links to master planogram library.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_count_max
attributes.business_glossary_term: POS (Point of Sale) Terminal Count Maximum

attributes.description: Minimum number of POS (Point of Sale) terminals typically deployed in stores of this format. Defines the lower bound of checkout capacity.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy_type
attributes.description: Typical pricing strategy employed by stores of this format. EDLP (Everyday Low Price) = consistent low prices; Hi-Lo (High-Low Pricing Strategy) = regular prices with frequent promotions; premium = higher prices with quality focus; discount = below-market pricing; dynamic = algorithmic pricing.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format use RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology for inventory tracking and shrinkage prevention. True if RFID is deployed; false otherwise.

attributes.name: ropis_capable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store) Capable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format are capable of supporting ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store) fulfillment. True if ROPIS is supported; false otherwise.

tag_set.value: ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store) Capable Flag

attributes.name: sfs_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format are capable of serving as SFS (Ship-from-Store) fulfillment nodes for e-commerce orders. True if SFS is supported; false otherwise.

attributes.name: size_band_max_sqft
attributes.description: Maximum store size in square feet for this format. Defines the upper bound of the typical size range.

attributes.name: size_band_min_sqft
attributes.description: Minimum store size in square feet for this format. Defines the lower bound of the typical size range.

attributes.name: staffing_model_type
attributes.description: Typical staffing and service model for this format. Full service = high staff-to-customer ratio with personalized assistance; self-service = minimal staff, customer-driven; automated = robotic/automated fulfillment.

attributes.name: target_demographic
attributes.description: Primary customer demographic segment targeted by this store format (e.g., value-conscious families, urban professionals, convenience shoppers, bulk buyers).

attributes.name: typical_sku_count_max
attributes.business_glossary_term: Typical SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) Count Maximum
attributes.description: Maximum number of SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) typically carried by stores of this format. Defines the upper bound of product assortment size.

tag_set.value: Typical SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) Count Maximum

attributes.name: typical_sku_count_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Typical SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) Count Minimum
attributes.description: Minimum number of SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) typically carried by stores of this format. Defines the lower bound of product assortment size.

tag_set.value: Typical SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) Count Minimum

attributes.name: wms_integration_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: WMS (Warehouse Management System) Integration Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format require integration with WMS (Warehouse Management System) for inventory management. True for fulfillment-heavy formats (dark stores, MFCs, SFS nodes); false for traditional retail-only formats.

tag_set.value: WMS (Warehouse Management System) Integration Required Flag

products.name: pos_terminal
products.description: Master record for every Point-of-Sale (POS) terminal deployed within a store location. Captures terminal ID, lane number, terminal type (staffed checkout lane, self-checkout kiosk, mobile POS, customer service desk, pharmacy register), hardware model, software version, payment acceptance capabilities (EMV chip, NFC/contactless, PIN debit, EBT/SNAP, mobile wallet), peripheral devices (scanner, scale, receipt printer), installation date, last maintenance date, next scheduled maintenance, terminal status (active, offline, maintenance, decommissioned), PCI DSS compliance certification date, and assigned department or zone within the store. Critical for POS transaction reconciliation, shrinkage investigation, lane productivity analysis, and omnichannel payment compliance.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the POS terminal. Primary key. Inferred role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_department. Business justification: POS terminals are assigned to specific departments within a store (e.g., electronics department checkout, grocery department checkout). The pos_terminal record currently denormalizes department_code a

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the store location where this POS terminal is deployed.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: POS terminals are capital equipment procured from hardware vendors. Tracking the vendor supports warranty claims, maintenance contract management, service call routing, and replacement parts procureme

attributes.name: barcode_scanner_type
attributes.description: Type of barcode scanner peripheral attached to the POS terminal. Determines scanning workflow and throughput capabilities.

attributes.name: cash_drawer_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal is connected to a cash drawer for handling cash transactions. False for self-checkout kiosks and mobile POS devices that do not accept cash.

attributes.name: contactless_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports Near Field Communication (NFC) contactless payments (tap-to-pay, mobile wallets like Apple Pay, Google Pay).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this POS terminal record was first created in the master data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customer_display_type
attributes.description: Type of customer-facing display device attached to the terminal. Shows transaction details, pricing, and promotional messages to the customer during checkout.

attributes.name: ebt_snap_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal is certified to accept Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) and Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) payments. Required for grocery retailers serving SNAP recipients.

attributes.name: emv_chip_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports EMV chip card transactions (contact chip reading). Required for PCI DSS compliance and fraud reduction.

attributes.name: encryption_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal encrypts payment card data at the point of interaction (P2PE - Point-to-Point Encryption). Required for PCI DSS compliance and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: hardware_model
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or identifier for the POS terminal hardware (e.g., 'NCR RealPOS 82XRT', 'Toshiba TCx Sky', 'Zebra TC52'). Critical for maintenance planning and compatibility management.

attributes.name: hardware_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number for the physical POS terminal device. Used for warranty tracking, asset management, and theft prevention.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the POS terminal was first installed and commissioned at the store location. Used for asset lifecycle tracking and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: Internet Protocol (IP) address assigned to the POS terminal on the store network. Used for network troubleshooting, security monitoring, and remote management.

attributes.name: lane_number
attributes.description: Physical lane or checkout position number within the store layout. Used for customer wayfinding and operational reporting. Null for mobile POS devices.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent preventive maintenance or repair service performed on the terminal. Used for maintenance schedule compliance tracking.

attributes.name: last_transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent transaction processed by this terminal. Used for terminal utilization analysis and anomaly detection (e.g., identifying inactive terminals).

attributes.name: mac_address
attributes.description: Media Access Control (MAC) address of the POS terminal network interface. Unique hardware identifier used for network access control and device authentication.

attributes.name: mobile_wallet_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports mobile wallet payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, etc.). Typically requires NFC hardware.

attributes.name: network_zone
attributes.description: Network security zone or segment where the POS terminal is deployed. Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) terminals are subject to stricter PCI DSS controls.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the next preventive maintenance service is scheduled for the terminal. Used for proactive maintenance planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: Operating system running on the POS terminal (e.g., 'Windows 10 IoT', 'Android 11', 'Linux Ubuntu 20.04'). Impacts security posture and application compatibility.

attributes.name: payment_processor
attributes.description: Name of the payment processing service or gateway integrated with this terminal (e.g., 'First Data', 'Worldpay', 'Square'). Determines payment acceptance capabilities and settlement routing.

attributes.name: pci_dss_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the terminal last passed Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance certification. Must be renewed annually to maintain payment acceptance capabilities.

attributes.name: pci_dss_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current PCI DSS certification expires. Terminals must be recertified before this date to continue processing payment card transactions.

attributes.name: pin_debit_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports PIN-based debit card transactions. Requires secure PIN pad hardware.

attributes.name: qr_code_payment_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports QR code-based payment methods (e.g., Alipay, WeChat Pay, retailer-specific QR payment apps).

attributes.name: receipt_printer_model
attributes.description: Model identifier for the receipt printer peripheral attached to the POS terminal. Used for consumables ordering and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: remote_management_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal can be remotely monitored, configured, and updated from a central management system. Enables efficient fleet management and rapid issue resolution.

attributes.name: scale_integrated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal has an integrated scale for weighing produce, bulk items, or other variable-weight merchandise. Common in grocery checkout lanes.

attributes.name: signature_capture_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports electronic signature capture for credit card transactions and delivery confirmations.

attributes.name: software_version
attributes.description: Version number of the POS application software currently installed on the terminal. Critical for security patch management and feature compatibility.

attributes.name: terminal_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the POS terminal, often indicating its location or purpose within the store (e.g., 'Lane 5', 'Customer Service Desk', 'Pharmacy Register').

attributes.name: terminal_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the POS terminal, typically displayed on the terminal and used in operational communications. Unique within a store location.

attributes.name: terminal_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the POS terminal. Determines whether the terminal is available for transaction processing. Active terminals are in production use; offline terminals are temporarily unavailable; maintenance terminals are undergoing service; decommissioned terminals are permanently retired.

attributes.name: terminal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the POS terminal based on its operational function and staffing model. Determines transaction workflows and customer interaction patterns.

attributes.name: tokenization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports payment tokenization, replacing sensitive card data with non-sensitive tokens for storage and transmission. Reduces PCI DSS scope.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this POS terminal record was last modified in the master data system. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

products.name: fixture
products.description: Master record for physical store fixtures including gondolas (shelving units), endcaps (end-of-aisle displays), cooler/freezer cases, pegboard panels, display tables, and checkout lane fixtures. Captures fixture ID, fixture type, manufacturer, model number, dimensions (width, height, depth), number of shelves, adjustable shelf flag, refrigeration type (ambient, chilled, frozen), installation date, last refurbishment date, assigned store location, assigned department/zone, and current planogram assignment. Supports visual merchandising planning, maintenance scheduling, and capital asset tracking.

attributes.name: fixture_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the store fixture. Primary key.

attributes.name: department_id

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store location where this fixture is currently assigned. Links to the store master record.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier from whom the fixture was purchased. Links to the supplier master record for procurement history and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: ada_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture meets ADA accessibility requirements for height, reach range, and clearance. True indicates compliant, false indicates non-compliant or exempted.

tag_set.value: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: adjustable_shelves_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture has adjustable shelf heights. True enables flexible merchandising for varying product sizes, false indicates fixed shelf positions.

attributes.name: aisle_number
attributes.description: Aisle identifier where the fixture is positioned within the store. Used for store navigation, planogram assignment, and customer wayfinding.

attributes.name: bay_position
attributes.description: Specific bay or section position within the aisle (e.g., Bay 1, Bay 2). Provides granular location tracking for planogram compliance and inventory audits.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Categorization of the fixture based on its intended duration and purpose. Permanent fixtures are long-term store infrastructure, seasonal fixtures support recurring seasonal merchandising, promotional fixtures are used for short-term campaigns, and temporary fixtures are ad-hoc displays.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the fixture, used for asset tracking and inventory management. Typically alphanumeric code assigned by merchandising or facilities team.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fixture record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: depth_inches
attributes.description: Depth of the fixture measured in inches. Important for aisle width planning, product capacity calculation, and customer navigation.

attributes.name: digital_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture includes digital signage or electronic shelf labels (ESL) for dynamic pricing and promotions. True indicates digital capability, false indicates traditional static signage.

attributes.name: finish_color
attributes.description: Color or finish of the fixture exterior (e.g., white, black, chrome, wood grain). Used for visual merchandising consistency and brand alignment across store fleet.

attributes.name: fixture_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixture. Active indicates in-use and operational, inactive indicates temporarily not in use, maintenance indicates undergoing repair or refurbishment, retired indicates permanently removed from service, damaged indicates requiring repair, and pending installation indicates purchased but not yet deployed.

attributes.name: fixture_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fixture by its primary merchandising function. Gondola refers to standard shelving units, endcap to end-of-aisle displays, cooler/freezer to refrigerated cases, pegboard to hanging merchandise panels, display table to promotional tables, checkout lane to POS area fixtures, shelf unit to standalone shelving, and rack to hanging garment fixtures. attributes.name: height_inches

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date the fixture was installed in its current store location. Used for age tracking, depreciation calculation, and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: last_refurbishment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent refurbishment, repair, or significant maintenance performed on the fixture. Null if never refurbished since installation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fixture record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: lighting_integrated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture has built-in lighting to highlight merchandise. True indicates integrated lighting system, false indicates no built-in lighting.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the fixture. Used for warranty tracking, parts sourcing, and vendor performance analysis.

attributes.name: material_composition
attributes.description: Primary materials used in fixture construction (e.g., steel, wood, laminate, glass, acrylic). Impacts durability, maintenance requirements, and aesthetic alignment with store design.

attributes.name: mobility_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture is permanently installed (fixed), easily movable (mobile with casters), or requires tools to relocate (semi-mobile). Impacts flexibility for store resets and seasonal merchandising changes.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model or part number for the fixture. Critical for ordering replacement parts, warranty claims, and standardization across stores.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next preventive maintenance or inspection. Used for maintenance scheduling and compliance with safety standards.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special handling instructions, maintenance history notes, or other relevant information about the fixture.

attributes.name: power_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture requires electrical power for operation (e.g., refrigeration, lighting, digital displays). True requires power connection, false indicates passive fixture.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number

attributes.name: refrigeration_type

Ambient indicates no refrigeration, chilled indicates 32-40°F range for dairy and produce, frozen indicates below 0°F for frozen foods, multi-temp indicates multiple temperature zones, and none indicates non-refrigerated fixtures.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture is equipped with RFID readers for automated inventory tracking and shrinkage prevention. True indicates RFID capability, false indicates no RFID integration.

attributes.name: security_features
attributes.description: Description of anti-theft or security features integrated into the fixture (e.g., locking doors, security hooks, EAS tag compatibility, camera integration). Used for shrinkage prevention and loss prevention planning.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number for the individual fixture unit. Used for warranty claims, theft recovery, and precise asset tracking.

attributes.name: shelf_count
attributes.description: Number of shelves or display levels on the fixture. Used for capacity planning and planogram assignment. Null for fixtures without shelves (e.g., pegboards, hanging racks).

attributes.name: weight_capacity_lbs
attributes.description: Maximum weight load the fixture can safely support, measured in pounds. Critical for safety compliance and preventing structural failure when merchandising heavy products.

attributes.name: width_inches
attributes.description: Width of the fixture measured in inches. Used for space planning, planogram design, and store layout optimization.

products.name: department
products.description: Master record for departments or selling zones within a store location — the primary sub-location operational unit in retail. Captures department ID, department name, department code, parent store location, floor number, zone coordinates, department type (grocery, apparel, electronics, household, pharmacy, bakery, deli, produce, frozen, health & beauty, seasonal, etc.), selling area (sq ft), number of fixtures, department manager assignment reference, labor budget allocation, and active status. Departments are the fundamental unit for planogram assignment, inventory allocation, staffing schedules, shrinkage attribution, and P&L sub-reporting within a store. Most operational KPIs (sales per sq ft, shrink rate, labor-to-sales ratio) are measured at department level.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the store department. Primary key for the store department entity.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Retail departments (e.g., grocery, electronics, apparel) are assigned department-level price lists that govern valid selling prices for items in that department. This supports department-level price l

attributes.name: license_number

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: omnichannel_fulfillment_enabled_flag

attributes.name: sales_target_monthly

attributes.name: selling_area_sq_ft

attributes.name: shrinkage_rate_percent

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag

products.name: cluster_membership
products.description: This association product represents the membership relationship between store clusters and store locations. It captures the assignment of individual stores to logical clusters used for localized assortment planning, zone pricing, promotional targeting, and operational benchmarking. Each record links one store cluster to one store location with effective dates, primary cluster designation, assignment reason, and status that exist only in the context of this relationship. Supports concurrent membership in multiple overlapping clustering schemes (assortment clusters, pricing zones, demographic clusters, performance tiers, climate zones).. Existence Justification: Store cluster membership is a genuine operational M:N relationship in retail. Retailers actively manage multiple concurrent clustering schemes (assortment clusters, pricing zones, demographic segments, performance tiers, climate zones) where a single store participates in multiple clusters simultaneously, and each cluster contains multiple stores. The relationship has its own lifecycle (effective dates), business rules (primary cluster designation), and operational significance (drives localized merchandising, pricing, and planning decisions).
