attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the vendor contact, if still used for formal document transmission.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: The given name of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: is_escalation_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact should be included in escalation workflows for critical issues such as compliance violations, quality failures, or delivery delays.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the primary point of contact for the vendor. Used for default routing of communications and escalations.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title or position of the contact within the vendor organization (e.g., Account Manager, Supply Chain Director, Compliance Officer).

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for business communications with this contact. Uses ISO 639-2 three-letter language codes.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: The most recent date when this vendor contact was engaged in business communication. Used for relationship health monitoring and engagement tracking.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: The family name or surname of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this vendor contact record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: The middle name or initial of the vendor contact person, if applicable.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the vendor contact. Used for urgent escalations and time-sensitive communications.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information about the vendor contact, such as special instructions, preferences, or relationship history.

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: The physical office location or site where this contact is based (e.g., headquarters, regional office, manufacturing plant).

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the vendor contact. Includes country code and extension if applicable.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the vendor contact's office location.

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method for receiving business communications. Supports personalized engagement and improved response rates.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the vendor contact's office is located.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The time zone where the vendor contact is located. Used for scheduling meetings and understanding business hours. Format follows IANA Time Zone Database (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London).

products.name: vendor_address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses for vendors including headquarters, remittance, ship-from, and returns (RTV) addresses. Tracks address type, street, city, state, postal code, country, geo-coordinates, and validation status. Supports procurement, logistics routing, and RTV processing.
products.reference: SAP Vendor Address (ADRC), GS1 Location Number (GLN)

attributes.name: vendor_address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor address record. Primary key.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor to whom this address belongs. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and building identifier. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, floor, department, or additional location details. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for complex addresses requiring additional location specification. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or label for the address location (e.g., 'Main Distribution Center', 'Corporate HQ', 'Returns Processing Facility').

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address: active (in use), inactive (no longer used), pending_validation (awaiting verification), invalid (failed validation), temporary (short-term use).

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address purpose: headquarters (corporate office), remittance (payment processing), ship_from (origin for DSD or shipments), returns (RTV processing location), billing (invoice address), warehouse (distribution or storage facility).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name where the vendor address is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country of the address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number for the location, used for business identity verification, credit assessment, and supplier risk management. 9-digit numeric identifier.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this address is no longer valid or was deactivated. Null indicates the address is currently active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this address became active and valid for use in procurement, logistics, and vendor transactions. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email contact for the address location, used for logistics coordination, RTV notifications, and operational communication. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the address location, used for EDI transmission or document exchange with vendors. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number uniquely identifying the physical location for EDI transactions, logistics routing, and supply chain integration. 13-digit numeric identifier.

attributes.name: is_dsd_location
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is a DSD (Direct Store Delivery) origin location where vendors deliver directly to retail stores bypassing distribution centers. True if DSD location, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_primary_address
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the primary or default address for the vendor. True if primary, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_remittance_address
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is used for payment remittance and accounts payable processing. True if remittance address, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_rtv_address
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is designated for RTV (Return to Vendor) processing and merchandise returns. True if RTV address, False otherwise. Critical for reverse logistics and vendor compliance.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last modified or updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geospatial routing, logistics optimization, and mapping. Supports last-mile delivery planning and ship-from-store calculations.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geospatial routing, logistics optimization, and mapping. Supports last-mile delivery planning and ship-from-store calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional address-specific information, special delivery instructions, access requirements, or operational notes for logistics and procurement teams.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the address location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for mail delivery routing. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit ZIP in USA, alphanumeric in Canada). Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional subdivision where the address is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction or district code applicable to this address location, used for sales tax calculation, VAT compliance, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago, Europe/London). Supports scheduling, delivery windows, and cross-timezone coordination.

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the address was last validated against postal authority or third-party address verification services. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: Name of the service or system used to validate the address (e.g., USPS Address Validation API, Canada Post AddressComplete, UPS Address Validation, manual verification).

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been verified against postal authority databases or third-party address validation services: validated (confirmed accurate), unvalidated (not yet checked), failed (does not match postal records), partial (some fields validated).

products.name: vendor_contract
products.description: Supplier trading agreements and master vendor contracts including terms and conditions, payment terms, discount structures, exclusivity clauses, private label agreements, and contract validity periods. Tracks contract type (national brand, private label, DSD), effective and expiry dates, auto-renewal flags, and signatory details. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD/MM contract management.
products.reference: SAP Outline Agreement (EKKO/EKPO), Oracle ORMS Vendor Agreement

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor contract. Primary key for the vendor contract entity.

attributes.name: receiving_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.location. Business justification: Vendor contracts specify which store or DC location receives goods — a core contract management and inbound logistics process. receiving_location_code is a denormalized text field; normalizing to loca

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.sales_territory. Business justification: Exclusive distribution agreements in retail are scoped to sales territories — a legally significant contract term. exclusivity_scope is a plain-text denormalization of territory; normalizing to sales_

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor party to this contract. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews at expiration. True if the contract extends for another term unless either party provides termination notice. False if the contract expires without action.

attributes.name: chargeback_terms
attributes.description: Description of vendor compliance penalties and chargeback conditions. Defines scenarios where the buyer may deduct fees from vendor payments for non-compliance (late delivery, incorrect labeling, missing ASN, pallet configuration errors).

attributes.name: compliance_certifications_required
attributes.description: List of regulatory and industry certifications the vendor must maintain to fulfill this contract. Examples include FDA registration for food suppliers, CPSC compliance for consumer products, organic certifications, fair trade certifications, and safety standards.

attributes.name: contract_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value and payment terms. All financial terms in this contract are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: contract_document_url
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Locator pointing to the digitally stored contract document. Links to the document management system or secure file repository where the full contract PDF or scanned image is stored.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the vendor contract. Used in procurement documents, purchase orders, and vendor communications.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vendor contract. Draft contracts are under negotiation. Pending approval contracts await internal sign-off. Active contracts are in force. Suspended contracts are temporarily paused. Terminated contracts are ended before expiry. Expired contracts have passed their end date. Renewed contracts have been extended. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|terminated|expired|renewed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor contract. National brand contracts cover branded merchandise from manufacturers. Private label contracts govern store-brand product manufacturing. DSD (Direct Store Delivery) contracts define vendor-managed delivery terms. Master service agreements cover ongoing services. Blanket orders establish terms for recurring purchases. Framework agreements set umbrella terms for multiple purchase orders.

attributes.name: contract_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value committed under this vendor contract. Represents the aggregate purchase commitment or spending cap over the contract term. Used for budget planning and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this vendor contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Standard discount rate applied to purchases under this contract. Expressed as a percentage off list price. Used for volume discounts, early payment discounts, or negotiated pricing agreements.

attributes.name: edi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Electronic Data Interchange is enabled for transactions under this contract. True if purchase orders, invoices, and shipping notices are exchanged via EDI. False for manual or email-based document exchange.

attributes.name: edi_identifier
attributes.description: Vendor EDI interchange identifier corresponding to the EDI qualifier. Used in EDI message headers to identify the sender and receiver.

attributes.name: edi_qualifier
attributes.description: EDI interchange identifier qualifier for the vendor. Examples include 01 (DUNS number), 12 (phone number), 14 (UPC), ZZ (mutually defined). Used to route EDI messages to the correct vendor system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor contract terms expire. Nullable for open-ended contracts. Procurement transactions must occur before this date unless the contract is renewed.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor contract terms become binding and enforceable. Procurement transactions referencing this contract must occur on or after this date.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract grants the vendor exclusive rights to supply specific products or categories. True if the buyer commits to purchasing exclusively from this vendor for the covered scope. False for non-exclusive agreements.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms code defining the division of costs and risks between buyer and seller. EXW (Ex Works) - buyer collects from vendor premises. FOB (Free On Board) - vendor delivers to shipping vessel. DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) - vendor delivers to buyer location with all duties paid. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: insurance_requirements
attributes.description: Minimum insurance coverage the vendor must carry to fulfill this contract. Typically includes general liability, product liability, and cargo insurance with specified coverage limits.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this vendor contract record was most recently modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of calendar days from purchase order submission to delivery at the receiving location. Used for replenishment planning, inventory forecasting, and order scheduling.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required per purchase order under this contract. Vendor will not accept orders below this threshold. Used for production planning and logistics optimization.

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity. Examples include EA (each), CS (case), PLT (pallet), KG (kilogram), LB (pound). Must align with vendor catalog and purchase order units.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional contract details, special terms, negotiation history, or operational notes. Used by procurement teams to capture context not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred payment instrument for settling invoices under this contract. ACH (Automated Clearing House) for electronic bank transfers. Wire transfer for same-day settlement. Check for paper-based payment. EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) payment for automated remittance. Credit card for small purchases. Letter of credit for international trade.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount structure. Examples include Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30 (2% discount if paid within 10 days, otherwise net 30 days).

attributes.name: quality_assurance_terms
attributes.description: Quality standards and inspection requirements for goods supplied under this contract. Defines acceptable quality levels, sampling procedures, defect rates, and vendor quality certifications required.

attributes.name: renewal_term_months
attributes.description: Duration in months for each automatic renewal period. Applicable only when auto_renewal_flag is true. Contract extends by this duration at each renewal.

attributes.name: return_to_vendor_policy
attributes.description: Terms governing the return of defective, damaged, or unsold merchandise to the vendor. Defines RTV authorization process, restocking fees, return shipping responsibility, and credit issuance timeline.

attributes.name: shipping_point
attributes.description: Vendor facility or distribution center from which goods are shipped under this contract. Used for logistics planning, freight cost calculation, and delivery time estimation.

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was signed by the authorized buyer representative. Used for contract validity verification and audit trail.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days advance notice required to terminate the contract. Either party must provide written notice this many days before the desired termination date.

attributes.name: vendor_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized representative who signed the contract on behalf of the vendor organization. Used for contract validation and audit trail.

attributes.name: vendor_signatory_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the vendor authorized signatory. Examples include CEO, VP Sales, Director of Business Development. Used to verify vendor signing authority.

attributes.name: vendor_signature_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was signed by the authorized vendor representative. Used for contract validity verification and audit trail.

attributes.name: vmi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Vendor Managed Inventory is enabled under this contract. True if the vendor monitors buyer inventory levels and automatically replenishes stock. False for buyer-managed replenishment.

products.name: chargeback
products.description: Vendor compliance penalty records issued to suppliers for violations of routing guides, labeling requirements (GS1-128, RFID/EPC), EDI non-compliance, late shipments, fill rate shortfalls, ASN failures, and packaging defects. Tracks chargeback type, violation category, violation date, penalty amount (flat fee or percentage), dispute status, resolution date, recovery method (AP deduction or separate debit memo), and linkage to the originating routing guide rule. Critical for vendor compliance enforcement, cost recovery, and feeds vendor scorecard KPIs. Supports automated penalty calculation and vendor portal notification workflows.
products.reference: SAP Debit Memo (FI), Oracle ORMS Vendor Chargeback

attributes.name: chargeback_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor compliance chargeback penalty record.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center or receiving facility where the compliance violation was detected.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.goods_receipt. Business justification: Chargebacks for receipt discrepancies (short shipments, damaged goods, labeling violations) require direct link to the specific goods_receipt event for validation, dispute resolution, and vendor score

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.inbound_shipment. Business justification: Chargebacks triggered by shipment violations (short ship, ASN non-compliance, seal failure) require direct reference to the inbound_shipment for root cause investigation and vendor dispute resolution.

attributes.name: lead_time_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.lead_time_agreement. attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order associated with the compliance violation that triggered this chargeback.

attributes.name: receiving_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.receiving_event. Business justification: Receiving discrepancy chargebacks (shortage, damage, overage) are directly triggered by receiving_event records containing discrepancy_reason_code and damage_flag. 'Receiving discrepancy chargeback' p

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to returns.rma. Business justification: Vendor chargebacks often stem from customer returns (damaged/defective goods). AP teams reconcile chargebacks against originating RMAs to validate penalty legitimacy and negotiate vendor disputes. Ena

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Chargebacks for quality, compliance, or labeling violations must identify affected SKUs. Business process: chargeback dispute resolution, root cause analysis, vendor scorecard impact assessment, and f

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_contract. Business justification: Chargebacks enforce contract compliance by penalizing vendors for violations. Linking to vendor_contract enables retrieving penalty schedules, dispute resolution procedures, and recovery methods defin

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor against whom this chargeback penalty is issued.

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_item. Business justification: Chargebacks for item-specific violations (incorrect labeling, wrong UPC/GTIN, non-compliant pack configuration, wrong case pack quantity) must reference the specific vendor_item catalog entry — not ju

attributes.name: vendor_promo_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.vendor_promo_agreement. Business justification: Promotional chargebacks are issued when vendors fail to fulfill promotional funding commitments. 'Promotional chargeback management' requires linking each chargeback to the specific vendor_promo_agree

attributes.name: violation_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Chargebacks for routing guide violations, labeling errors, or receiving discrepancies originate at specific receiving locations (stores or DCs). Tracking the violation location supports root cause ana

attributes.name: affected_units
attributes.description: The number of units (SKUs, cartons, or pallets) impacted by the compliance violation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the chargeback was formally approved for issuance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID of the procurement or compliance manager who approved the chargeback for issuance to the vendor.

attributes.name: chargeback_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the chargeback penalty, used in vendor communications and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: chargeback_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the chargeback penalty in the dispute and recovery workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|issued|disputed|under_review|approved|rejected|paid|written_off|cancelled — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.description: High-level category of the compliance violation that triggered the chargeback penalty. attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chargeback record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the penalty amount.

attributes.name: debit_memo_number
attributes.description: The external document number of the debit memo issued to the vendor for the chargeback penalty, if applicable.

attributes.name: detection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance violation was formally identified and logged in the system, which may differ from the violation date.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor formally disputed the chargeback penalty.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the vendor for disputing the chargeback, including supporting evidence references.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has disputed the chargeback and the current state of the dispute resolution process.

attributes.name: is_repeat_violation
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this chargeback represents a repeat violation of the same compliance rule by the vendor within a defined time window.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chargeback record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, supporting documentation references, or special handling instructions related to the chargeback.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the vendor of the chargeback penalty.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the chargeback notification was sent to the vendor through the vendor portal or EDI channel.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the chargeback penalty assessed against the vendor for the compliance violation.

attributes.name: penalty_calculation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate the chargeback penalty amount, such as a fixed flat fee or a percentage of the order value.

attributes.name: penalty_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to the order or shipment value when the penalty calculation method is percentage-based.

attributes.name: previous_violation_count
attributes.description: The number of prior chargebacks issued to this vendor for the same violation category within the trailing 12-month period.

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the chargeback penalty amount was successfully recovered from the vendor through the specified recovery method.

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: The mechanism used to recover the chargeback penalty amount from the vendor, such as accounts payable deduction or separate debit memo.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the chargeback dispute was resolved and a final decision was made.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes documenting the outcome of the dispute resolution process, including any adjustments or waivers granted.

attributes.name: vendor_scorecard_impact
attributes.description: The negative impact score applied to the vendors performance scorecard as a result of this chargeback, used in vendor relationship management and future sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: violation_category
attributes.description: Detailed classification of the specific compliance rule or requirement that was violated, such as GS1-128 labeling failure, RFID tag missing, or incorrect pallet configuration.

attributes.name: violation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance violation occurred or was detected by the receiving facility or quality control process.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or automated process that created the chargeback record.

products.name: vendor_scorecard
products.description: Periodic vendor performance scorecards measuring KPIs including on-time delivery rate, fill rate, EDI compliance rate, invoice accuracy, chargeback frequency, product quality scores, and overall vendor rating. Tracks scoring period, individual KPI values, weighted composite score, tier classification (preferred, approved, probation), and trend vs prior period. Enables strategic vendor relationship management.
products.reference: Oracle ORMS Vendor Performance, NRF Vendor Compliance Standards

attributes.name: vendor_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor scorecard record. Primary key. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER (scorecard is a periodic performance evaluation event).

attributes.name: supply_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.purchase_order. Business justification: Scorecards measure vendor performance (on-time delivery, fill rate, invoice accuracy) across PO history. Retail buyers review scorecard metrics tied to specific POs for vendor negotiations, tier assig

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_contract. Business justification: Vendor scorecards measure performance against contract SLAs (on-time delivery rate, fill rate, EDI compliance). Linking to vendor_contract enables comparing actual performance metrics to contractual c

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor being evaluated in this scorecard. Links to the vendor master data entity.

attributes.name: chargeback_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of chargebacks assessed against the vendor during the scoring period, typically in USD.

attributes.name: chargeback_count
attributes.description: Total number of chargebacks (vendor compliance penalties) issued to the vendor during the scoring period for violations such as late delivery, incorrect labeling, or packaging non-compliance.

attributes.name: composite_score
attributes.description: Weighted overall vendor performance score calculated from individual KPI values (on-time delivery, fill rate, quality, etc.). Scale typically 0-100. Used for vendor tier classification.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the vendor must submit a corrective action plan if required.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the vendor is required to submit a corrective action plan based on scorecard results (true if performance is below acceptable thresholds).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scorecard record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this scorecard (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: edi_compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of transactions (purchase orders, ASNs, invoices) successfully transmitted via EDI without errors or manual intervention during the scoring period.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when the scorecard was completed and finalized by the evaluator.

attributes.name: fill_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered quantity that was fulfilled by the vendor during the scoring period. Measures vendor ability to meet demand without stockouts.

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of invoices submitted without pricing, quantity, or calculation errors during the scoring period. Measures vendor billing quality.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scorecard record was last modified.

attributes.name: lead_time_adherence_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of orders where the vendor met the agreed lead time from order placement to delivery during the scoring period.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity_compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of orders where the vendor honored MOQ agreements without imposing additional fees or rejecting orders during the scoring period.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, context, or qualitative observations about vendor performance during the scoring period.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders or shipments delivered on or before the promised delivery date during the scoring period. Key KPI for vendor reliability.

attributes.name: prior_period_composite_score
attributes.description: Composite score from the previous scoring period, used to calculate trend and performance improvement or decline.

attributes.name: product_quality_score
attributes.description: Composite quality score based on defect rates, customer returns, and quality inspection results for products supplied by the vendor during the scoring period. Scale typically 0-100.

attributes.name: return_to_vendor_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of goods returned to the vendor during the scoring period, typically in USD.

attributes.name: return_to_vendor_count
attributes.description: Total number of RTV transactions initiated during the scoring period due to defects, overstock, or non-compliance.

attributes.name: score_trend
attributes.description: Directional trend of vendor performance compared to the prior period (improving, stable, or declining).

attributes.name: scorecard_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the scorecard, typically formatted as SC-YYYYMMDD or similar pattern for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: scorecard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scorecard indicating whether it is in draft, published for vendor review, under internal review, finalized, or archived.

attributes.name: scoring_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the evaluation period covered by this scorecard (e.g., end of quarter or month).

attributes.name: scoring_period_start_date

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Storefronts often represent specific physical stores' online presence for store-specific inventory visibility, local pricing, BOPIS fulfillment, and "shop my store" features. Real business process: st

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the price book or pricing list assigned to this storefront, sourced from Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) or the e-commerce platform. Governs the base retail prices (AUR — Average Unit Retail) and EDLP (Everyday Low Price) rules applied to products displayed on this channel. Critical for channel-specific pricing strategy execution.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Each regional or country-specific ecommerce storefront operates within a defined price zone governing base price multipliers, markdown limits, and currency rules. Retail pricing operations require sto

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.region. Business justification: Regulatory compliance and regional pricing: storefronts must be scoped to a region for GDPR/CCPA enforcement, fiscal calendar alignment, tax jurisdiction assignment, and regional promotional campaign

attributes.name: sfs_fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.sfs_fulfillment_node. Business justification: Ship-from-store operations: storefronts with is_ship_from_store_enabled must be linked to their SFS fulfillment node for order routing, same-day/next-day cutoff time display, daily capacity management

attributes.name: analytics_tracking_code
attributes.description: The web analytics platform tracking identifier assigned to this storefront (e.g., Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID 'G-XXXXXXXXXX' or Adobe Analytics Report Suite ID). Used to attribute digital customer journey events, CTR (Click-Through Rate), CR (Conversion Rate), and session data to the correct storefront channel. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary analytics configuration.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront has activated the CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' opt-out mechanism, required for storefronts serving California consumers. Governs data sharing controls and consumer rights workflows.

tag_set.value: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Enabled Flag

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Classification of the digital commerce channel operated by this storefront. Segments storefronts by their primary consumer interface: web (desktop/browser), mobile_app (iOS/Android native), marketplace (third-party platform such as Amazon or eBay), social_commerce (shoppable social media), or dark_store (fulfillment-only digital channel). Drives channel-specific analytics including CTR, CR, and GMV reporting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code indicating the primary geographic market served by this storefront (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'GBR'). Used for regulatory compliance scoping (GDPR, CCPA, FTC), tax jurisdiction assignment, and regional assortment planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this storefront record was first created in the system of record (the e-commerce platform or the customer master data system). Represents the audit trail creation event for data governance and lineage tracking purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary transactional currency for this storefront (e.g., 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR'). Governs pricing display, checkout totals, AOV calculations, and GMV reporting. Aligns with Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) currency configuration.

attributes.name: customer_service_email
attributes.description: The operational customer service email address displayed to customers on this storefront for support inquiries, returns (RMA — Return Merchandise Authorization), and complaints. Routed to the case management system for case management. Classified confidential as an organizational contact identifier.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this storefront was or is scheduled to be permanently retired and removed from active digital commerce operations. Nullable for currently active storefronts. Used for channel sunset planning, data retention scheduling, and regulatory compliance archival.

attributes.name: default_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code representing the default display language for this storefront (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'es'). Used when a customer's browser language preference cannot be resolved or when the storefront operates in a single-language mode. Distinct from locale_code which also encodes regional formatting.

attributes.name: domain_url
attributes.description: The primary public-facing domain URL for this storefront (e.g., 'https://www.retail.com' or 'https://m.retail.com'). Used for SEO configuration, SSL certificate management, CDN routing, and digital marketing attribution. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary digital infrastructure configuration.

attributes.name: free_shipping_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum order value (in the storefront's primary currency) at which free standard shipping is automatically applied at checkout. A key lever for AOV (Average Order Value) optimization and customer acquisition. Configured in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) or the e-commerce platform promotion rules.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront is subject to GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) consent requirements, triggering cookie consent banners, data processing notices, and opt-in workflows for customers in EU/EEA jurisdictions. Drives compliance configuration in the e-commerce platform and CRM systems.

attributes.name: is_bopis_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports the BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) fulfillment mode, allowing customers to purchase online and collect from a physical store location. Drives fulfillment routing logic in the OMS (Order Management System) and store operations workflows.

tag_set.value: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Enabled Flag

attributes.name: is_drop_ship_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports drop-ship fulfillment, where vendors ship products directly to customers without passing through Retail's DC (Distribution Center). Relevant for extended assortment and marketplace-style operations. Aligns with supplier management and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) integration.

attributes.name: is_loyalty_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront is integrated with Retail's customer loyalty and engagement program, enabling points accrual, redemption, and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) tracking at the digital channel level. Drives loyalty-specific promotional targeting and RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) segmentation.

attributes.name: is_ropis_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store), allowing customers to reserve items online without payment and collect them in-store. Distinct from BOPIS in that no payment transaction occurs at the digital checkout stage.

tag_set.value: Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS) Enabled Flag

attributes.name: is_ship_from_store_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports SFS (Ship-from-Store) fulfillment, where physical store locations act as fulfillment centers for online orders. Enables distributed inventory utilization and faster last-mile delivery. Integrates with Manhattan Associates WMS for store-level pick/pack/ship operations.

attributes.name: is_ship_to_home_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports ship-to-home fulfillment, where orders are dispatched from a DC (Distribution Center) or store directly to the customer's delivery address. Governs last-mile delivery eligibility and carrier integration activation for this channel.

attributes.name: is_tax_inclusive_pricing
attributes.description: Indicates whether product prices displayed on this storefront include taxes (tax-inclusive, common in EU/UK markets) or exclude taxes (tax-exclusive, common in US markets). Governs price display logic at the product listing and checkout stages. Aligns with Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) tax display configuration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this storefront record was most recently updated in the system of record. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this storefront was first made publicly available to customers. Used for channel age analysis, anniversary promotions, and historical performance benchmarking. Represents the effective-from date for the storefront's commercial lifecycle.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code defining the primary language and regional formatting for this storefront (e.g., 'en_US', 'fr_CA', 'es_MX'). Controls language display, date/number formatting, and content localization within the e-commerce platform. Critical for omnichannel customer experience consistency.

attributes.name: max_cart_line_items
attributes.description: The maximum number of distinct line items (SKUs) permitted in a single shopping cart session on this storefront. Governs cart capacity limits configured in the e-commerce platform to manage checkout performance and order processing capacity. Relevant for B2B or bulk-purchase storefronts.

attributes.name: min_order_amount
attributes.description: The minimum cart value (in the storefront's primary currency) required for a customer to complete checkout on this storefront. Used to enforce MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) value thresholds, qualify for free shipping promotions, or meet marketplace seller requirements. Configured in the e-commerce platform checkout rules.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the digital storefront or online channel (e.g., 'Retail Main Site', 'Retail Mobile App', 'Retail Marketplace — Amazon'). Used in reporting dashboards, operational tooling, and business communications.

attributes.name: pci_compliance_level
attributes.description: The PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) merchant compliance level assigned to this storefront, determined by annual card transaction volume (Level 1: >6M transactions; Level 2: 1M–6M; Level 3: 20K–1M; Level 4: <20K). Governs the scope of annual security assessments and SAQ (Self-Assessment Questionnaire) requirements. Classified confidential as it reveals security posture.

attributes.name: platform_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the the e-commerce platform (SFCC) platform release deployed for this storefront (e.g., 'SFCC 23.7', 'B2C Commerce 22.10'). Used for release management, compatibility tracking, and upgrade planning across the digital commerce estate.

attributes.name: robots_indexing_policy
attributes.description: The default robots meta directive applied to this storefront, controlling whether search engine crawlers may index pages and follow links (e.g., 'index_follow' for the main site, 'noindex_nofollow' for staging or dark-store channels). Impacts organic search visibility and SEO strategy.

attributes.name: seo_meta_title
attributes.description: The default HTML meta title tag content for the storefront's homepage, used by search engines for indexing and SERP (Search Engine Results Page) display. Impacts organic search traffic and digital marketing performance. Managed within the e-commerce platform site preferences.

attributes.name: session_timeout_minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes of customer inactivity after which a shopping session is automatically expired on this storefront. Governs cart abandonment timing, session-based analytics, and security compliance for authenticated customer sessions. Configured in the e-commerce platform site security settings.

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique site identifier assigned within the e-commerce platform (SFCC) for this storefront. Used as the operational reference key across digital commerce platform configurations, API calls, and integration touchpoints. Aligns to the SFCC Site object's siteID field.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this storefront record was sourced or last updated (e.g., 'SFCC' for the e-commerce platform, 'MDM' for the customer master data system, 'MANUAL' for manually entered records). Used for data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and master data governance within the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: storefront_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the storefront. 'active' indicates the storefront is live and accepting customer traffic; 'maintenance' indicates a temporary service window; 'draft' indicates pre-launch configuration; 'decommissioned' indicates the channel has been permanently retired. Governs whether the storefront is eligible for traffic routing, promotional targeting, and digital commerce operations.

attributes.name: supported_payment_methods
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of payment methods accepted at checkout on this storefront (e.g., 'credit_card,debit_card,paypal,apple_pay,google_pay,gift_card,buy_now_pay_later'). Governs payment gateway configuration and PCI DSS compliance scope for this channel. Managed within the e-commerce platform payment processor settings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|apple_pay|google_pay|gift_card|buy_now_pay_later|bank_transfer — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary tax jurisdiction applicable to this storefront for sales tax, VAT, or GST calculation purposes (e.g., 'US-CA', 'CA-ON', 'GB'). Used by the tax engine integrated with the e-commerce platform to apply correct tax rates at checkout. Aligns with FASB ASC 606 revenue recognition and FTC pricing transparency requirements.

attributes.name: theme_code
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the visual theme or template applied to this storefront within the e-commerce platform (e.g., 'sfra-retail-v3', 'pwa-kit-2024'). Controls the storefront's UI/UX presentation layer, including layout, typography, and brand styling. Used by digital merchandising and visual merchandising teams for planogram-equivalent digital shelf configuration.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the storefront's primary operating time zone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'America/Los_Angeles'). Used for scheduling promotional campaigns, flash sales, maintenance windows, and business-hours-based SLA calculations. Aligns with the e-commerce platform site time zone configuration.

products.name: digital_catalog
products.description: E-commerce product catalog record representing the published, channel-specific view of merchandise available on a given storefront. Tracks which SKUs are active online, digital content completeness (images, descriptions, rich media), SEO metadata (title, meta description, canonical URL), online availability flags, digital-only pricing overrides, and publication status. This is the digital presentation layer — distinct from the master product catalog in the product domain which owns canonical SKU/UPC definitions and the master merchandise hierarchy.

attributes.name: digital_catalog_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each digital catalog record representing a channel-specific published view of a SKU on a given storefront. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a digital presentation asset managed and published via the e-commerce platform.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_brand. Business justification: Brand landing pages, brand-level SEO, and brand content management in ecommerce require digital catalog entries to reference the canonical brand record. brand_name is a denormalized representation of

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: Omnichannel category management: digital catalog entries must reference the store department for cross-channel category performance reporting, planogram alignment, and department-level promotional eli

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Products displayed online show store-specific availability and fulfillment options. Real business process: "check store availability" feature, store-specific assortment display, local inventory querie

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Retail catalog publication workflows scope digital catalogs to a specific price list (e.g., 'Holiday Catalog', 'Wholesale Price List'). Content managers and pricing teams use this link to control whic

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Product pages display active promotions; linking enables merchandising teams to verify promotional pricing accuracy across catalog, SEO teams to optimize promotional landing pages, and compliance team

attributes.name: return_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to returns.return_policy. Business justification: Product detail pages must display the applicable return policy at point of sale — an FTC-guided retail disclosure requirement. Linking digital_catalog to return_policy enables PDP return policy displa

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Catalog publishing process requires authoritative link to product master for attributes, compliance flags, lifecycle status, vendor data, and pricing rules. Retail operations depend on single source o

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: Digital catalog product pages must display authoritative online prices from sku_price, which maintains channel-specific and zone-specific pricing. Core business process: e-commerce price display and c

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_item. Business justification: Drop-ship catalog management requires knowing which vendor item record backs each digital listing — governing cost, pack config, lead time, and DSD eligibility. Merchandising and drop-ship onboarding

attributes.name: age_restriction
attributes.description: Age-gating requirement for this SKU on the digital storefront, applicable to regulated product categories such as alcohol, tobacco, and certain pharmaceuticals. Drives age verification workflows at checkout. Regulated by FTC and FDA.

attributes.name: canonical_url
attributes.description: The canonical URL of the product detail page (PDP) used to prevent duplicate content issues across multiple storefront URLs or faceted navigation paths. Declared in the HTML link rel=canonical tag. Managed in the e-commerce platform.

attributes.name: content_completeness_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0.00–100.00) measuring how complete the digital content is for this catalog record, based on presence of required fields such as title, description, images, SEO metadata, and rich media. Used to prioritize content enrichment efforts and improve Conversion Rate (CR).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this digital catalog record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and content age analysis. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the online_price for this digital catalog record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency storefronts in international e-commerce operations.

attributes.name: has_video
attributes.description: Indicates whether at least one product video (e.g., demonstration, unboxing, lifestyle) is published for this SKU on the storefront. Rich media presence is a key driver of Conversion Rate (CR) improvement in digital commerce.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU contains hazardous materials subject to special shipping, handling, or labeling requirements. Affects last-mile delivery eligibility and carrier selection in the Order Management System (OMS). Regulated by CPSC and OSHA.

attributes.name: image_count
attributes.description: Total number of product images published for this SKU on the storefront, including hero, alternate angles, lifestyle, and swatch images. Used to measure digital content completeness and identify SKUs requiring additional imagery.

attributes.name: is_drop_ship_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is fulfilled via Drop Ship, where the vendor ships directly to the customer without passing through a Distribution Center (DC). Relevant for extended aisle and marketplace assortment strategies.

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU has been manually designated as a featured product by digital merchandisers, qualifying it for placement in featured product carousels, homepage spotlights, or category hero positions on the storefront.

attributes.name: is_online_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is currently available for purchase on the digital storefront. Distinct from publication_status — a product may be published but temporarily unavailable due to inventory depletion or fulfillment constraints. Drives add-to-cart eligibility.

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a private label (store brand) product owned and sold exclusively by the retailer. Private label products typically carry higher gross margins and are a key strategic differentiator in assortment planning.

attributes.name: is_searchable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is indexed and returned in on-site search results on the digital storefront. A product may be published but excluded from search (e.g., exclusive landing page products or clearance items managed via direct URL only).

attributes.name: last_published_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this digital catalog record was most recently published or re-published to the live storefront. Used for content freshness tracking, cache invalidation, and audit trails in the e-commerce platform.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code specifying the language and regional variant for this digital catalog record (e.g., en-US, fr-CA, es-MX). Supports multi-locale storefront content management and international e-commerce operations in the e-commerce platform.

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Full consumer-facing product description displayed on the product detail page (PDP), including features, benefits, materials, and usage instructions. Supports rich HTML formatting. Managed in the e-commerce platform content management.

attributes.name: primary_image_url
attributes.description: URL of the primary hero product image displayed on the product detail page (PDP) and product listing pages (PLP). Hosted on the digital asset management (DAM) system or CDN. Critical for digital content completeness scoring.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The consumer-facing product title as displayed on the digital storefront. May differ from the master product name in PIM to reflect channel-specific merchandising copy or A/B tested titles. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the digital catalog record on the storefront. Controls whether the SKU is visible and purchasable by online shoppers. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|published|unpublished|scheduled|archived|suspended — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: publish_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this digital catalog record is scheduled to be or was deactivated and removed from the storefront. Used for seasonal assortment management, limited-time offers, and clearance markdown lifecycle management.

attributes.name: publish_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this digital catalog record is scheduled to become or became active and visible on the storefront. Used for pre-launch product scheduling and promotional launch coordination in the e-commerce platform.

attributes.name: rating_average
attributes.description: Average customer review rating for this SKU on the digital storefront, on a scale of 0.00 to 5.00. Aggregated from verified purchase reviews. Used in product ranking algorithms, content completeness scoring, and conversion rate optimization analytics.

attributes.name: review_count
attributes.description: Total number of published customer reviews for this SKU on the digital storefront. Used alongside rating_average to assess review volume credibility and identify SKUs requiring review generation campaigns.

attributes.name: seo_meta_description
attributes.description: The HTML meta description tag for the product detail page (PDP), summarizing the product for search engine result snippets. Typically 150-160 characters. Drives organic Click-Through Rate (CTR) from search engine results pages.

attributes.name: seo_title
attributes.description: The HTML page title tag for the product detail page (PDP), optimized for search engine indexing. Typically limited to 60 characters per SEO best practices. Managed in the e-commerce platform content management.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Brief consumer-facing product description displayed in product listing pages (PLP) and search results. Typically 100-200 characters. Sourced from the e-commerce platform product content and may differ from the master description in PIM.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric position used to control the default display sequence of this SKU within its assigned digital category on the storefront. Lower values appear first. Used by merchandisers to manually curate product listing page (PLP) rankings.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this digital catalog record originated or was last updated. Supports data lineage tracking across the e-commerce platform (SFCC), Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS), the customer master data system, and Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).

attributes.name: tax_category_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code assigned to this SKU for digital commerce tax calculation purposes, determining applicable sales tax rates at checkout. Mapped to tax engine rules in the e-commerce platform. Relevant for FDA-regulated food items with tax exemptions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this digital catalog record was most recently modified, including content updates, price changes, status transitions, or SEO edits. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: url_slug
attributes.description: The human-readable URL path segment for the product detail page (PDP), used in constructing the storefront URL. Must be lowercase, hyphen-separated, and unique per storefront. Example: 'mens-slim-fit-chino-pants-navy'.

products.name: web_session
products.description: Tracks individual visitor sessions on digital storefronts, capturing session start/end timestamps, device type, browser, OS, referral source, UTM parameters, landing page, exit page, page view count, session duration, and whether the session resulted in a cart creation, checkout initiation, or completed order. Supports CTR, CR, and digital journey analytics. High-volume event data — recommend 90-day hot retention with archival to cold storage for historical trend analysis.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual visitor session on the digital storefront. Primary key for the web_session data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopping cart created or interacted with during this session. Enables abandoned cart analysis and cart-level GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) attribution even when no order is placed.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order placed during this session, if is_order_placed is True. Enables direct linkage between digital session analytics and order-level GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) and AOV (Average Order Value) reporting.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated customer associated with this session. Null for anonymous/guest sessions. Enables online-to-offline attribution and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) analysis.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Sessions originate from promotional emails, paid search for promotional keywords, or circular ad QR codes; tracking campaign attribution at session level is fundamental to digital marketing ROI, omnic

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Sessions initiated via offer-specific links (email campaigns, affiliate offers) require offer-level attribution for conversion funnel analysis. Offer-driven session reporting, personalization engine i

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront or e-commerce site where the session occurred. Supports multi-brand and multi-region digital commerce operations.

attributes.name: browser_name
attributes.description: Name of the web browser used during the session (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). Used for compatibility analysis and identifying browser-specific conversion drop-offs in the digital funnel.

attributes.name: browser_version
attributes.description: Version string of the web browser used during the session. Supports technical compatibility analysis and identification of outdated browser populations impacting checkout CR (Conversion Rate).

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice or cookie policy presented to the visitor at session start. Enables compliance audit trails demonstrating which consent framework version was in effect at the time of data collection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp indicating when this web session record was first captured and written to the Silver Layer data product. Distinct from session_start_timestamp which reflects the real-world event time.

attributes.name: data_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor provided explicit consent for data collection and tracking during this session, as required under GDPR and CCPA. True = consent granted. Governs permissible use of session data for analytics and personalization.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of device used by the visitor during the session. Supports omnichannel digital journey analytics and device-specific CR (Conversion Rate) and AOV (Average Order Value) reporting.

attributes.name: exit_page_url
attributes.description: Full URL of the last page viewed before the visitor ended the session. Used to identify drop-off points in the digital funnel and optimize checkout flow to improve CR (Conversion Rate).

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Fulfillment method selected or browsed during the session. BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store), home_delivery, ship_from_store (SFS), or drop_ship. Supports omnichannel attribution and last-mile delivery analytics.

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code inferred from the visitor's IP address or browser locale. Supports international digital commerce analytics and regional GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) reporting.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the visitor at session initiation. Used for geolocation inference, fraud detection, and bot traffic filtering. May be considered PII under GDPR/CCPA in some jurisdictions. Stored in compliance with data minimization principles.

attributes.name: is_bot
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session was identified as automated bot or crawler traffic rather than a genuine human visitor. True = bot session. Used to filter non-human traffic from CR (Conversion Rate), CTR (Click-Through Rate), and Footfall analytics.

attributes.name: is_bounce
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session was a bounce — the visitor viewed only a single page and exited without further interaction. True = bounce session. Used to calculate bounce rate as a digital storefront health KPI.

attributes.name: is_cart_created
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor created a shopping cart (added at least one item) during this session. True = cart was created. Key funnel stage flag for CR (Conversion Rate) and abandoned cart analysis in the e-commerce platform.

attributes.name: is_checkout_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor initiated the checkout flow during this session. True = checkout was started. Enables measurement of cart-to-checkout conversion rate and identification of checkout abandonment in the digital funnel.

attributes.name: is_order_placed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session resulted in a completed order placement. True = order was placed. Primary conversion flag for CR (Conversion Rate) calculation and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) attribution to digital sessions.

attributes.name: landing_page_url
attributes.description: Full URL of the first page viewed by the visitor upon entering the digital storefront. Critical for measuring landing page CR (Conversion Rate) and identifying high-performing entry points in the digital customer journey.

attributes.name: last_search_query
attributes.description: The most recent on-site search term entered by the visitor during the session. Supports merchandising and assortment planning by revealing demand signals and zero-result search patterns.

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: Operating system of the visitor's device during the session (e.g., Windows, macOS, iOS, Android). Used for device ecosystem analysis and platform-specific performance optimization.

attributes.name: page_view_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct pages viewed by the visitor during the session. Indicator of session engagement depth and product discovery behavior. Used in basket analysis and digital journey analytics.

attributes.name: referral_source
attributes.description: High-level channel classification of how the visitor arrived at the digital storefront. Supports digital marketing attribution, CTR (Click-Through Rate) analysis, and channel-level CR (Conversion Rate) reporting. attributes.name: referral_url

attributes.name: cart_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shopping cart. 'active' indicates the cart is open and being interacted with; 'abandoned' indicates the session timed out or the customer left without checkout; 'converted' indicates the cart was successfully submitted as an order; 'expired' indicates the cart exceeded the maximum retention window; 'merged' indicates the cart was consolidated with another cart (e.g., guest-to-authenticated merge). attributes.name: channel

attributes.name: converted_timestamp

attributes.name: coupon_redemption_channel

attributes.name: coupon_redemption_status

'applied' means the code was entered and discount applied; 'validated' means the code passed validation rules but discount is pending; 'rejected' means the code failed validation (expired, invalid, usage limit exceeded); 'reversed' means a previously applied discount was removed. Supports promotion effectiveness and fraud monitoring.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the cart instance was first created in the system, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the start of the cart lifecycle. Used for cart age calculation, session duration analysis, and abandonment timeout determination.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this cart (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency storefronts and international e-commerce operations. All amount fields on this cart are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: data_consent_flag

attributes.name: device_type

attributes.name: discount_amount

attributes.name: estimated_shipping_amount

attributes.name: estimated_tax_amount
attributes.description: Estimated sales tax calculated on the cart based on the customer's shipping destination and applicable tax jurisdiction rules. This is an estimate at cart stage; final tax is confirmed at order submission. Supports pre-checkout transparency requirements per FTC pricing standards.

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this cart is scheduled to expire and be purged from the active cart pool if not converted or explicitly abandoned. Determined by storefront-level cart retention policy configuration. Used for cart lifecycle management, data retention compliance, and inventory reservation release scheduling.

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: The intended fulfillment method selected by the customer for this cart. Values include standard Ship-to-Home, Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS), Ship-from-Store (SFS), and Drop Ship (vendor direct-to-customer). Drives downstream Order Management System (OMS) routing and Last-Mile Delivery planning.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the customer's device at the time of cart creation. Used for geolocation-based tax and shipping estimation, fraud detection, and digital analytics. attributes.name: is_abandoned
